publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The traditional Vehicular Ad-hoc Network (VANET) routing algorithms are just designed based on the scenario of a single service traffic type and RAT, without designing personalized routing schemes for different types of service traffic. Software Defined Vehicular Network (SDVN) paradigm can solve these problems with its centralized control feature. We propose an intelligent SDVN architecture for the VANET scenarios with different types of service traffic and various RATs. Then we propose a hierarchical intelligent routing algorithm based on Q-learning considering the different personalized needs of various traffic types. The simulation results show that the algorithm can meet the personalized requirements of various traffic, and has better performance in delay-packet loss rate-cost.

articleTitle: Non-invasive Image Quality Assessment Based on Eye-tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to measure the perceptual quality of images, it is important to find suitable Image Quality Assessment (IQA) methods. Compared with the traditional objective IQA methods, the subjective IQA methods can more truly reflect users’ subjective feelings on image quality. However, the evaluation steps in subjective experiments will interfere with the process of subjects viewing images. We propose a non-intrusive IQA method based on eye-tracking technology to overcome the shortcoming. Through subjective experiments, we collect the eye movement data of subjects and calculate four main features from them. The analysis results of the eye movement parameters indicate that users pay attention to different areas of images with different qualities. Then, we use the eye movement parameters to design the Non-Intrusive Subjective (NIS) IQA algorithm which is a new subjective quality metric of images. Experimental results reveal that the validity and feasibility of the proposed metric.

articleTitle: Joint DOA and TOA Estimation for Multipath OFDM Signals Based on Gram Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Among the existing methods for joint estimation of direction of arrival (DOA) and time of arrival (TOA) in OFDM system, such as multiple signal classification (MUSIC) and estimating signal parameters viarotational invariance techniques (ESPRIT), sufficient sampling snapshots are required to achieve high precision. In this paper, we first analyze the constituent parts of the gram matrix of received signals under multicarrier scenario. While estimating DOA, it is proved that received signals from different subcarriers can be approximately regarded as multiple snapshots, received signals from different antennas are utilized for TOA estimation likewise. However, a certain amount of disturbance is introduced due to the cross correlation components. Thus, an improved eigenvector (EV) method is proposed to mitigate such adverse impacts. Simulation results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Efficient Authenticated Key Agreement Protocol for D2D Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In view of the security and efficiency of key agreement in D2D communication, we propose an authenticated key agreement protocol without bilinear pairing. The proposed protocol, which adopts the certificateless cryptosystem, realizes the authentication and key agreement based on the ECC discrete logarithm problem. Theoretical analysis shows that the protocol is secure and reliable under the general certificateless model, which is able to resist replay attack, man-in-middle attack, key leakage attack, with the forward and backward secrecy. Simulation results show that the protocol has advantages in negotiation time and computation cost compared with similar protocols.

articleTitle: Priority Based Adaptive MAC Protocol for UAV Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a priority based adaptive MAC protocol (PM-MAC) is proposed for UAV ad hoc networks. Firstly, in the protocol, the arriving packets are classified into different queues according to the priority of services. A Markov chain model is proposed to analyze the channel access probabilities of different queues. And it is ensured that packets with high priority can access the channel with high probability. Secondly, the size of contention window is adaptively adjusted based on backoff times and the current packet size. Finally, simulation results show that PM-MAC can guarantee the access requirements of high priority packets, and compared with the traditional backoff method, the backoff mechanism in PM-MAC achieves better performance in access success rate, channel utilization and backoff delay.

articleTitle: A Reliable Joint MCMA and DD-LMS for Lite DSP in Short-Reach Self-Homodyne Optical Coherent Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a highly convergent joint modified constant modulus and Decision-Directed least mean square (DD-LMS) algorithm for adaptive blind polarization demultiplexing in the elastic datacenter optical networks (EONs). We compare the proposed joint algorithm with traditional constant modulus algorithm (CMA) and modified constant modulus algorithm (MCMA), in terms of performance in 840-Gbit/s dual-polarization 64QAM Self-Homodyne detection (SHD) system. The simulation result shows that the proposed joint algorithm can not only simultaneously accomplish polarization de-multiplexing and phase recovery at low bit error rate (BER) level, but also simplify DSP and reduce power consumption.

articleTitle: Multi-domain Time Synchronization Model and Performance Evaluation in TSN
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) has precise time synchronization capabilities and can provide reliable time-deterministic services for industrial communications and other fields. IEEE 802.1AS is used as the time synchronization protocol in TSN and has support for multiple gPTP domains, which further expands the application range of TSN and enhances the synchronization capabilities of TSN. Industrial automation and other use cases also have multi-domain time synchronization requirements of TSN, but there is still a lack of research in this field. Therefore, this paper studies the multi-domain synchronization mechanism in TSN and proposes the multi-domain time synchronization model according to actual application requirements. Based on the multi-domain model, this paper analyzes the time errors in multi-domain time synchronization, introduces the SDN paradigm, and proposes a software-defined time compensation method to compensate the time errors centrally. Further, the time synchronization experiment environment is built to analyze synchronization performance. The results verify the effectiveness of the multi-domain time synchronization model, demonstrating that the multi-domain TSN network can provide high-precision time synchronization services.

articleTitle: LDPC Assisted Blind Frame Synchronization: Efficient Measurement Mechanism and Low-Complexity Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, low-density parity-check (LDPC) assisted blind frame synchronization (BFS) is studied to balance a tradeoff between the frame synchronization error rate performance and computational complexity. Specifically, we develop an efficient measurement mechanism related to the parity-check matrix to choose suitable LDPC codes for BFS. Furthermore, a low-complexity multi-stage search (MSS)-BFS algorithm is proposed, where the number of candidate positions gradually decreases as the growth of iteration number. Finally, simulation results show that the proposed measurement mechanism is reliable to choose LDPC codes for BFS, and the MSS-BFS algorithm can achieve comparable performance to conventional algorithm with eminently reduced iterations.

articleTitle: An Electromagnetic Environment Situation Assessment and Abnormal Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Electromagnetic environment situation is an important part of battlefield situation, which plays an important reference role in battlefield situation and battlefield threat assessment, and can provide a strong basis for combat command. To better grasp the electromagnetic environment situation, from the time domain, spatial domain, frequency domain, energy and so on, we put forward 10 from the trend of the state and characterization of indicators, to systematically describes the electromagnetic environment situation, based on the adaptive neural fuzzy system (ANFIS) electromagnetic environment situation assessment model was constructed, according to the evaluation results to detect electromagnetic environment changes. The evaluation ability of the model is verified by experiments with the short-wave spectrum monitoring data, and the function of abnormal situation detection in electromagnetic environment is realized.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Balancing Strategy Based on Link Preference in SDN
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of link congestion and data packet loss caused by link load imbalance in Software-Defined Network (SDN), a dynamic load balancing strategy based on link preference (LBBLP) is proposed. The SDN controller dynamically detects the link status of the data plane to get the bandwidth utilization of each link, and then maps the link bandwidth utilization to the link preference. The traffic is scheduled based on link preference to realize the even distribution of the traffic among the link. To achieve dynamic routing control, the mapping relationship between link bandwidth utilization and link preference changes dynamically with network traffic and link bandwidth utilization. Experiments show that LBBLP can effectively improve the network load balancing effect and reduce the packet loss rate.

articleTitle: Classifying Object of Standard Grasping Movements Using Data Glove with LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes an object classification method using a data glove and deep learning. The classification is performed based on 22 joint angle values obtained from a standard grasp movement on a target object. The relation between fingers’ joint angles and the shape of the target object are described by a superellipsoid model and a simple kinematic model of the human hand. A GraspBiLSTM model is addressed as the classification model. The standard grasping movement experiment dataset of different objects is exacted by Ninapro Dataset 1 Exercise C. According to the experimental results, the accuracy of the GraspBiLSTM classification model is above 90% for 15 daily life objects with standard grasping movements. A data glove that can perform object classification is successfully developed in this work and achieves recognition of objects in an insufficient light environment.

articleTitle: For RF Signal-Based UAV States Recognition, Is Pre-processing Still Important At The Era Of Deep Learning?
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs, also called drones) have been widely deployed in our living environments for a range of applications such as healthcare, agriculture, and logistics. Despite their unprecedented advantages, the increased number of UAVs and their growing threats demand high-performance management and emergency control strategies. To accurately detect a UAV’s working state including hovering and flying, data collection from Radio Frequency (RF) signals is a key step of these strategies and has thus attracted significant research interest. Deep neural networks (DNNs) have been applied for UAV state detection and shown promising potentials. While existing work mostly focuses on improving the DNN structures, we discover that RF signals’ pre-processing before sending them to the classification model is as important as improving the DNN structures. Experiments on a dataset show that, after applying proposed pre-processing methods, the 10-time average accuracy is improved from 46.8% to 91.9%, achieving nearly 50% gain comparing with the benchmark work using the same DNN structure. This work also outperforms the state-of-the-art CNN models, confirming the great potentials of data pre-processing for RF-based UAV state detection.

articleTitle: A Grid-Based Virtual Routing Algorithm for UAV Systems in Three-Dimensional Space
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to mobility of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), many UAVs are used to expand the communication range and relay data communication in military and civil scenarios. UAV network will have a new impact on network performance due to its unique three-dimensional space operation and its own high-speed mobility. In this paper, we propose a three-dimensional grid based virtual routing (3D-GVR) algorithm to improve network performance. We determine the size of the three-dimensional grid based on the effective communication range of the UAV and the heartbeat time of the UAV, and then transmit it as a whole through virtual routing. Finally, the proposed 3D-GVR algorithm is evaluated by simulation. Simulation results show that this method is superior to DSDV and GPSR in packet overhead, packet transmission rate and average time.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Repetition-based Grant-free Access for URLLC
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the context of ultra-reliable low latency communication (URLLC) becoming the dominant demand of wireless communication, the method of enhancing the reliability of Grant-free (GF) transmission technology through hybrid automatic retransmission request (HARQ) needs to be further improved. In this paper, a GF-HARQ transmission scheme combined with repetitions is proposed and the outage probability of the system under sporadic small packets arrive is studied. Firstly, we establish the system model and analyze the transmission delay of a HARQ round trip according to the transmission principle. Then, combined with the delay constraint of QoS delivery under URLLC short packet transmission, the maximum transmission number of times M is obtained. Next, the system outage probability is deduced based on random geometry and probability theory. Finally, we verify the accuracy of the outage probability by simulation and compare the performance with the GF-HARQ scheme. Our results show that the proposed scheme provides higher reliability.

articleTitle: A Unified Programming Model over Heterogeneous Data Planes
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Software Defined Networking (SDN) separates the data plane and the control plane in the traditional network, and the data plane communicates with the control plane through standard protocols. With the development of SDN, there are many southbound communication protocols in academia, such as OpenFlow, Protocol Oblivious Forwarding (POF), Programming protocol-independent packet processors (P4). The design ideas and implementation of these protocols are very different. Therefore, many controllers provide some high-level Application Programming Interfaces (API) supporting different protocols to shield the complexity of the protocol and facilitate the writing of network strategies, but none of them can support different southbound protocols at the runtime. That is, the controller can’t support a variety of different protocols while the data plane has kinds of switches. For example, Open Network Operating System (ONOS) supports P4 and OpenFlow, but it can only support a specific data plane at the runtime, so it cannot combine the strengths and advantages of different types of programmable switches. This paper proposes a unified programming model that can support both the P4 and POF protocols at the runtime so that network users can combine the high performance of the P4 and the flexibility of the POF. We also provide kinds of API to facilitate the writing of network strategies. In certain application scenarios, the losing of data packets caused by updating the data plane pipeline can be effectively eliminated with the programming model.

articleTitle: Leveraging Ensemble Learning for Side Channel Analysis on Masked AES
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Symmetric cryptographic functions are known to leak secret information through power side channels. Although masking provides an effective mitigation to such leakage, these protection designs are vulnerable to advanced side-channel analysis based on machine learning. In this work, we propose a framework to leverage ensemble learning for power analysis on a masked AES implementation. Before the key recovery, we use machine learning techniques including decision tree, random forest, BP nerual network, and ensemble learning to recover the masks. We also implement data set enhancement through oversampling techniques including random oversampling, synthetic minority over-sampling technique (SMOTE), k-means-SMOTE, Borderline-SMOTE, and SMOTENC. In addition, we explore different ensemble learning methods on key recovery of power side-channel attacks. Experimental results on DPA contest v4 power traces show that ensemble learning methods improve the attack success rate by approximately 11.29% on average over neural network attacks. The results also reveal that data set enhancement can help reduce the variations in attack success rates between different key bytes.

articleTitle: Minimum Cost Hybrid Node Protection in NFV
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In network function virtualization (NFV), the customer’s service requests are delivered by going through a set of deployed service functions (SFs). To accommodate customer’s requests, service providers have to install the required SFs onto a physical network (PN) and route the traffic through the installed SFs to form a traffic forwarding path called the service function path (SFP). Any failures of physical nodes or SF instances can significantly impact the service delivery. In the literature, existing work has focused on how to protect the PN from physical node failures. Few research attention has been paid to efficiently protecting the network while jointly taking physical and virtual node failures into consideration. In this work, we investigate a novel minimum cost hybrid node protection (MC-HOP) problem, which is proved to be an NP-hard problem. We propose an efficient algorithm called minimum cost pairwise node assistance (NOTION) to optimize the MC-HOP problem with latency requirements. Extensive simulations and analysis show that the proposed scheme significantly outperforms the algorithms that are directly extended from the existing work.

articleTitle: Layered Security Multicast Algorithm based on Security Energy Efficiency Maximization in SCMA Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper studies the hierarchical secure multicast algorithm in sparse code multiple access (SCMA) networks, its network security capacity is no longer limited by the users with the worst channel quality in multicast group. Firstly, we propose a network security energy efficiency (SEE) maximization problem. Secondly, in order to reduce the computational complexity, we propose a suboptimal algorithm (SA), which separates the codebook assignment with artificial noise from the power allocation with artificial noise. To further decrease the complexity of Lagrange method, a power allocation algorithm with increased fixed power is introduced. Finally, simulation results show that the network performance of the proposed algorithm in SCMA network is significantly better than that in orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) network.

articleTitle: Intelligent Knowledge Modeling and Distributed Database Constructing for Intelligent Radar Countermeasure
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Intelligent radar countermeasure are the current development trend in the field of radar countermeasure. Knowledge modeling can support the whole process of radar countermeasure. It can not only provide prior knowledge for the countermeasure system but also dynamically update the generated new knowledge. To deal with the rapidly growing mass of knowledge in the knowledge base system, the use of a distributed architecture can ensure the stability of the knowledge base. At present, there are two difficulties in the construction of a knowledge base system in radar countermeasure. First, it is difficult to construct a comprehensive representation for multiple data sources and complex counter-targets. Second, the massive data and knowledge gives huge pressure for storage. To deal with the above problems, we systematically design a hierarchical dynamic knowledge base as well as several sub-databases based on the specific application of intelligent radar countermeasure. Furthermore, the distributed database based on the architecture of Mycat is constructed, which relieves the pressure on storage, reading and writing, as well as the crash risk of a single machine. We have demonstrated the performance of the distributed knowledge base.

articleTitle: Dynamic Missing Data Recovery Method with Low Complexity in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For the large-scale and high-dimensional internet of things (IoT) data, the missing values are very intractable, which affect the performance of related applications greatly. Based on this, a dynamic missing data recovery method with low complexity is proposed in this paper. Firstly, we use matrix factorization (MF) technology to map the IoT data to low dimensional space for analysis and processing. Then, taking full advantage of the characteristics of IoT data, the objective function of MF is improved furtherly. Last, the dynamic updating mechanism with low complexity is proposed to update the missing data recovery model constructed when new sampled data comes. The simulation results on two real data sets indicate the proposed method can effectively recover the missing data.

articleTitle: Image Stitching via Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Image stitching aims at generating a panorama from a sequence of images with overlapping areas. Many approaches have been dedicated to deal with the task. However, they usually require handcrafted features and multiple fulfilling steps, which may incur high time cost and intermediate interference. Recently, deep networks have been applied in this area, but mainly focused on specific steps of image stitching, such as feature extraction and image alignment, not enabling an end-to-end stitching. In this paper, we propose a novel convolutional neural network (CNN) based method which can perform image stitching in an end-to-end fashion. Qualitative and quantitative results from experiments on synthetic image datasets verify the excellent performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Improved Variable Step Size LMSTDE Algorithm Based on Fourth-order Cumulant
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Two-stage positioning method is widely used in multi-star positioning for satellite interference sources. The estimating accuracy of time difference of arrival (TDOA) has an important impact on the positioning results. Under the influence of correlated Gaussian noise and low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), the estimating accuracy of TDOA is seriously reduced. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved least mean square time difference estimation (LMSTDE) algorithm based on fourth-order cumulant. Firstly, the signal is preprocessed by using the self fourth-order cumulant and cross fourth-order cumulant to filter out the correlated Gaussian noise. Then, a new variable step size model based on arctangent function is proposed to improve the estimating accuracy under low SNR. Simulation results show that, compared with other methods, the proposed algorithm can improve the convergence speed and the estimating accuracy of TDOA under the correlated Gaussian noise and low SNR.

articleTitle: Infrared Image Brightness Correction for TIR Object Tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Thermal imaging has been widely used in numerous applications of computer vision. However, in infrared videos, drastic change to bright or dark is a common phenomenon. 8bit thermal image suddenly turning bright or dark mainly caused by two reasons: change in light and dark pixel values distribution and the temperature change inside the infrared camera during photography. As a result, both the tracking performance and the visual effect are affected. To this end, we analyzed the problem from the principle of infrared imaging. We proposed a brightness correction algorithm based on the Kalman filter, which suppressed adjacent frames’ brightness flickers, thus improving both tracking performance and visual effect. Experiments on a standard tracking benchmark LSOTB-TIR demonstrate that our algorithm achieves better tracking performance on flickering sequences while not negatively influencing regular infrared videos.

articleTitle: A2C Deep Reinforcement Learning-based MEC Network for Offloading and Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nowadays, various neural network models based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have been proposed to find the optimal strategy of computation offloading and resource allocation especially in Mobile Edge Computing (MEC). However, due to the complexity and the different types of computing tasks in 5G, the current DRL algorithms are difficult to be applied to complex MEC scenarios directly. This paper applies the normalized characteristic matrix to split the complex network into small network units and proposes a normalized network model for complex network scenarios based on Advantage Actor Critical (A2C) algorithm to find the computation offloading and resource allocation strategy.

articleTitle: Joint Trajectory Planning and Resource Allocation for UAV-assisted Information Collection
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, unmanned aerial vehicles have been considered to implement information collection tasks by taking photos for points of interest in many scenarios like disaster relief. Most existing related works focused on maximizing the number of points of interest visited under the constraint of limited energy capacity of the Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). In this paper, we consider the situation in which a UAV is deployed to collect information in a target area with limited energy capacity and storage capacity. Moreover, we consider the UAV can not only process the data collected with limited computation capacity but also send it back to the ground terminal for processing. To maximize the number of points of interest visited, we jointly optimize the trajectory and resource allocation of the UAV. Due to the NP-hardness of the formulated optimization problem, we propose a deep reinforcement learning based method to implement the decision-making. Experimental results show that our proposed algorithm is efficient in information collection tasks.

articleTitle: Path Loss in Metro Train in mm-wave Band with Consideration of Human Body Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Metro trains are densely populated, where human body occlusion has a great influence on radio propagation. Based on ray tracing (RT) technology and human body models, this paper investigates the channel characteristics in metro train with consideration of human body effect at 38 GHz millimeter wave (mm-wave) band. Due to human body occlusion, the line of sight (LOS) does not always exist, so the LOS probability is discussed, and the metro train area is divided into LOS, obstructed LOS (OLOS) and non-LOS (NLOS) regions. The additional loss is modelled, and the path loss models are obtained.

articleTitle: Combined Neural Network Based on Deep Learning for AMR
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Automatic modulation recognition (AMR) plays an important role in cognitive radio and electronic reconnaissance applications. In order to solve the problem that the lack of modulation signal data sets, the labeled data sets are generated by the software radio equipment NI-USRP 2920 and LabVIEW software development tool. In this paper, a combined network based on deep learning is proposed to identify ten types of digital modulation signals. Convolutional neural network (CNN) and Inception network are trained on different data sets, respectively. We combine CNN with Inception network to distinguish different modulation signals well. Experimental results show that our proposed method can recognize ten types of digital modulation signals with high identification accuracy, even in scenarios with a low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: A Real-time Embedded Target Tracking System Based on Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Target tracking has been arousing increasing attention in current production and life. Usually, target tracking algorithms are deployed on high-performance servers. There are significant challenges in deploying real-time target tracking in embedded systems. Therefore, a real-time embedded target tracking system is studied based on a deep learning model in this paper. Firstly, the hardware implementation of the proposed system is presented in detail. Then, to resolve the problems of high latency and low performance in embedded platforms, we offer an adaptive detection strategy that combines the advantages of deep network model inference and prediction. This strategy makes full use of the target relevance between the front and rear frames of video, reduces the frequency of calling the depth model, and improves the system's speed. Finally, Experiments have proved that the system can effectively reduce the time delays by more than 50% while ensuring the same detection effect. Meanwhile, the system's power consumption and resource occupancy rate are also significantly improved.

articleTitle: MMReLU: A Simple and Smooth Activation Function with High Convergence Speed
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Activation functions have a major effect on deep networks’ performance. In past few years, there is an increasing interest in the construction of novel activation functions. In this paper, we introduced a novel non-monotonic activation function, named Moreau Mish Rectified Linear Unit (MMReLU). It’s simple, efficient, and robust, comparing with Mish, ReLU, and etc. The experimental results on several classical datasets demonstrate that MMReLU outperforms its counterparts in both convergence speed and accuracy. We show that the capacity of neural networks could be enhanced by MMReLU without changing the network structure, especially the convergence speed.

articleTitle: Failure Prediction Based on LSTM and SVM under SDON Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence in data center optical network is very popular these years. In this paper, we proposed an optical network failure prediction scheme based on long short-term memory (LSTM) and support vector machine (SVM) under Software Defined Optical Network (SDON) architecture. LSTM is used to predict parameters of the optical network in the future, and then SVM is used to judge whether the network will fail. The prediction accuracy can reach 0.9063 which means this method is efficient. When the failure is predicted to occur, the controller issues instructions to avoid the failure.

articleTitle: Design of Transponder Message Transmission Mechanism Based on Error Correction Code BCH
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of the message sent by the Lineside Electronic Unit (LEU) to the active transponder and reduce the channel interference in message transmission, this paper will use the system cyclic code BCH (15,11) code to perform error correction coding on the message. Starting from the principle of encoding and decoding of BCH codes, this paper proposes a method of implementing encoding and decoding based on hardware circuits, and proves the correctness of the encoding and decoding algorithms through simulation. Finally, this article also analyzes the system's symbol error rate performance. The hardware circuit in the article is simple in design and high in realizability, which is suitable for practical applications in engineering.

articleTitle: Region-and-Attention Network for Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this article, we address the task of semantic segmentation by aggregating the information of feature regions at different scales and modeling the dependency between regions by combining the attention mechanism. Instead of using global pooling to bundle information from each channel into a single value in the past, we propose a Region-and-Attention Network (RANet) to pay attention to local features and their global dependence at the regional level. Specifically, we use different pooling rates for the high-level output to obtain multi-scale information aggregates, and regard the multi-channel sequence contained in each pixel position in the pooling result as the global information integration of the corresponding region before the feature layer pooling. Unlike SENet, we perform a separate channel attention transformation for the regional information represented by each pixel position, and use one-dimensional convolution instead of multi-layer perceptrons. The final segmentation result is enhanced region-level prediction by fusing RANet outputs at different pooling scales. The proposed approach achieves advanced segmentation performance on two challenging common segmentation datasets, Cityscapes and Pascal VOC.

articleTitle: Intelligent Answer System Based on Vulnerability Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Analyzing security vulnerabilities is of great significance to network protection. Although existing CVE and other databases contain rich vulnerability information, they are poorly readable and difficult to express the correlation between vulnerabilities and vulnerabilities, and between vulnerabilities and affected entities. In addition, the existing database does not support natural language retrieval, and non-professionals have certain difficulties in retrieval. Therefore, a security vulnerability ontology is designed, and then a knowledge graph is constructed; intent identification and slot filling of natural language questions are performed to complete semantic analysis; on this basis, an intelligent question answering system based on the vulnerability knowledge graph is designed and implemented. Experiments have proved that the system can simplify the user’s process of vulnerability information retrieval and query, and is convenient for mining the potential value of vulnerability database information.

articleTitle: Joint Resource Allocation for Online and Offline Tasks in Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nowadays an increasing number of online tasks and offline tasks from all industries are accommodated by the widely deployed data centers. These online tasks usually have strict Quality of Service (QoS) requirements and follow periodic load patterns. It is important to co-locate online tasks and the offline tasks that are not so sensitive to time delays to improve the resource utilization of data centers. Most existing solutions only focused on the resource management for online tasks, and ignored the features of offline tasks. In this paper, we establish the performance models for online tasks and offline tasks, respective-ly, and propose a virtual computing resource allocation scheme based on the dynamic resource sharing strategy. This scheme utilizes the time-varying characteristics of online workloads to maximize the utilization of the temporary available resource, while guaranteeing the QoS of delay-sensitive services. Thus the impact of hybrid deployment on the execution of offline tasks can be alleviated. The simulation results showed the effectiveness of the proposed scheme in guaranteeing the QoS and improving the resource utilization in data centers.

articleTitle: MTdt:Enabling Meta-Transactions for Data Tracking of Industrial Workflow
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The decentralization and traceability of blockchain technology can realize the supervision of industrial Internet industry processes. As a jointly maintained distributed ledger, blockchain can provide an open, transparent and tamper proof information publicity platform. However, due to the huge amount of data and complex data interface of IOT equipment, blockchain cannot become a platform for direct access of IOT system. Nowadays, more and more decentralized applications are born. Building such services using emerging blockchain technology is a promising direction. We attempt to use the latest blockchain proxy strategy to solve data management problems in the system. We propose a blockchain sub-proxy model that traces workflows. Host data links to proxies, blockchain only store necessary information to ensure that subsequent transactions can be traced back to previous operations. Multiple tasks are represented by distributed agents to form a complete industry chain. In this model, industrial processes can be recorded asynchronously and on a large scale. Unlike centralized management processes, agents and blocks work together to ensure data storage efficiency and security.

articleTitle: The Trust Evaluation and Anomaly Detection Model of Industrial Control Equipment Based on Multiservice and Multi-attribute
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the industrial control system, in order to solve the problem that the installation of smart devices in a transparent environment are faced with the unknown attack problems, because most of the industrial control equipment to detect unknown risks, Therefore, by studying the security protection of the current industrial control system and the trust mechanism that should be widely used in the Internet of things, this paper presents the abnormal node detection mode based on comprehensive trust applied to the industrial control system scenarios. This model firstly proposes a model, which fuses direct and indirect trust values into current trust values through support algorithm and vector similarity algorithm, and then combines them with historical trust values, and gives the calculation method of each trust value. Finally, a method to determine abnormal nodes based on comprehensive trust degree is given to realize a detection process for all industrial control nodes. By analyzing the real data case provided by Melbourne Water, it is concluded that this model can improve the detection range and detection accuracy of abnormal nodes. It can accurately judge and effectively resist malicious behavior and also have a good resistance to aggression.

articleTitle: A Maximum Average Weight Matching Algorithm for Collective Tasks Allocation in the Collective Computing System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Collective computing is the latest generation of computing frameworks that have received a lot of attention recently. In this framework, different types of remote computing devices and even "human" are connected to the system as independent computing devices, which can be used to perform different types of complex tasks with huge amounts of resources. Therefore, the various computing devices have different computing capabilities that can be fully utilized in different tasks. However, research on collective computing is still relatively limited, and in particular, there is a gap in research on task matching methods for collective computing. This paper proposes a task matching method for collective computing systems. We first propose a new index to describe the evaluation of devices by tasks in collective computing systems. Afterwards, a maximum average weight matching algorithm is proposed for solving the optimal matching problem for weighted bipartite graphs in this scenario. Finally, we integrate the whole process into the collective computing system and perform related experiments with satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A Differential Privacy Mechanism Combining Randomized Response with Laplace Distribution
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: By combining randomized response with Laplace distribution, it obtains a new kind of differential privacy mechanism called Pseudo-Laplace mechanism. By analyzing the privacy and data availability of the mechanism, as well as an optimization problem that provides better privacy protection than the Laplace mechanism based solely on the Laplace distribution (traditional Laplace mechanism) under the same data availability, and the instantiations of the mechanism obtained in the approximate optimization algorithm, it finds that the mechanism could have almost the same privacy protection level in the middle and high privacy protection region (approximately ε < 5 ) and better privacy protection level in the low privacy protection region (approximately ε ≥5 ) than the traditional Laplace mechanism under the same data availability. It has important practical implications for many practical applications where data availability is prioritized while better user privacy is protected.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-target Tracking Trajectory Association Algorithm in Dense Clutter Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to solve the trajectory association of multi-target tracking in dense clutter environment, we propose a joint probabilistic data association algorithm based on Sequential Probability Ratio Test with the simplified association probability(S-SPRT-JPDA). First, we use the sequential probability ratio test to introduce a target tracking management system, to solve the problem of the trajectory initiation and termination in dense clutter environment; and we redefine the confirmation matrix in the joint probability data association algorithm to simplify the calculation of the association probability when the target and the measurement are interconnected. The theoretical analysis and simulation experimental results show that the algorithm runs faster by 55% under the condition of ensuring the accuracy of association, which greatly reduces the calculation amount of trajectory association algorithm in the process of multi-target tracking and effectively improves the real-time performance of multi-target tracking data association algorithm in dense clutter environment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Congestion-Control Strategy for LEO Satellite Based on NS3
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As a branch of the simulation field, network simulation technology is increasingly becoming a powerful tool for analysis, research and design. In recent years, the Network Simulator 3 (NS3) simulator has made significant progress with its rich network component object library and relatively perfect bottom-level programming modelling. However, most of the current research on NS3 is based on the existing algorithms for differentiation and comparative analysis, lacking the open-source platform design, the training means of satellite communication system simulation and research on the overall platform building framework based on NS3. This article proposes a complete congestion-control open-source platform construction strategy for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite. The top-level building process of the satellite simulation platform is introduced in detail, and the bottom layer is modularized into four parts to achieve. The NS3 top-level frame realization process and the bottom-level network element unit are modularized to build a complete satellite model simulation platform. It provides some ideas for promoting the development of satellite routing algorithm simulation experiments.

articleTitle: IRS-Assisted Secure Communications Against Simultaneous Jamming and Eavesdropping
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Both the jammer and the eavesdropper pose severe threat to wireless communications due to the broadcast nature of wireless channels. In this paper, an intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) assisted secure communication system is considered, where a base station (BS) wishes to reliably convey information to a user in the presence of both a jammer and an eavesdropper. We aim to maximize the system achievable rate by jointly designing the BS’s transmit beamforming and the IRS’s reflect beamforming, while meeting the maximum transmit power constraint, the minimum signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio requirement of the legitimate user against jamming, and the minimum secrecy rate constraint of the legitimate user against eavesdropping. Due to the non-convexity and intractability of the original problem, we apply the Charnes-Cooper transformation to convert the original optimization problem into a tractable convex optimization problem, and then obtain the high-quality optimal solution by using the semidefinite relaxation (SDR) techniques and alternative optimization. Numerical simulations demonstrate the superiority of our proposed optimization algorithm compared with existing approaches, and also provide useful guidance into optimally deploying IRS in the secure communication system.

articleTitle: A PCIe-based Hardware Acceleration Architecture of the Communication Protocol Stack
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of 5G (5th Generation Mobile Communication Technology) communication technology, image transmission is more frequently used in people's work and life. It is important to make the high-speed transmission of video images in communication. This paper proposes a PCIe-based hardware acceleration architecture of the communication protocol stack. In this architecture, the PCIe (Peripheral Component Interconnect expresses) is integrated into a standard interface for complete the interaction between PC (Personal Computer) and FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array), transferring part of physical layer data processing functions into FPGA for completing the hardware simulation accelerate. The data collected by the camera is used as the user input of the protocol stack to simulate the video images transmission scene. Due to the limitation of experimental conditions, this paper used the OAI (OpenAirInterface) simulation platform to simulate the downlink of the physical layer, and successfully constructed the hardware-accelerated architecture of communication protocol stack under the scene of video and image transmission. This architecture has high realizability and can be used in high-speed data transmission architecture.

articleTitle: Identification and Analysis of Key Nodes in Power Optical Network Based on Node Contribution
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: When a key node in the power grid fails, the entire network may be paralyzed, which has a huge impact on society. Therefore, the key node identification of power optical network has great research significance. This paper proposes a key node identification algorithm for power optical network based on node contribution. Considering the importance of neighbor nodes and their relative weights, this paper innovatively proposes the index of node contribution. Then it combines degree centrality and betweenness centrality, through the combination of entropy weight method and TOPSIS sorting algorithm, the importance of the node in the network topology layer is obtained. Finally, combined with the business importance of the power optical network node, we get the comprehensive importance of the power optical network node. The paper uses MATLAB to simulate and analyze the real power network of a certain province. By comparing the ranking results and ranking frequencies of different algorithms, it is proved that the algorithm in this paper can distinguish the ranking of each node in a finer manner, and the identification of nodes is more detailed. Through the change of the network loss after attacking the key nodes, it proves the accuracy and effectiveness of the algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: Priority-Based Scheduling Approach to Minimize the SLA Violations in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In a virtualized datacenter, the Service Level Agreement for an application restricts the Virtual Machines (VMs) placement. The scheduling algorithm is responsible of route the user request to a specific VM, this scheduling process impact directly the SLA. An optimal scheduling approach aim to minimize the SLA violations and maximize the provider resources utilization. This paper presents a two-phases scheduling approach that can apply in geo-distributed data center environment, the first phase is to select the suitable data center to process the user request, while the second phase is to choose the suitable VM. The purpose is to minimize the SLA violations in term of Response time, availability and reliability. Our solution is also distinguishing standard request from high priority requests during the scheduling decision.

articleTitle: Improved Dynamic Artificial Potential Field Method Based on Remote Sensing of Internet of Vehicles and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Internet of Vehicles has increased the demand for obstacle avoidance algorithms for autonomous vehicles in dynamic scenarios. Artificial potential field method has become a local obstacle avoidance scheme adopted by many autonomous vehicles thanks to its advantages such as the removal of the need for drawing the map, low computational cost and high real-time performance. However, when facing a larger obstacle perception radius in the environment of IoV, it may mistakenly consider remote targets without collision risk into obstacle avoidance calculation. In addition, when facing a dynamic obstacle, the direction of avoidance may be the same as the movement of the obstacle, resulting in redundant obstacle avoidance or even collision. Therefore, it is necessary to transform the traditional method to adapt to new scenarios. An improved artificial potential field method based on Kalman filter prediction is proposed in this paper, which can avoid the calculation of possible targets without collision risk in a large perception range, and can produce a better path and higher security in the face of dynamic obstacle avoidance. In this paper, extensive simulation experiments under various dynamic scenarios are carried out and demonstrate that our method performs better and avoids collisions where original method fails.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Uplink-dominate Frame Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Vertical industries generate different traffic types that impose very diverse and extreme requirements on the network. Currently vendors and operators had been gradually noticed in the need to support more advanced applications with stricter reliability, throughput and latency requirements, such as XR, vision-based factory detection, remote medical service and live video. How to improve the UL data rate to meet the strict requirements for newly applications is an important step for network evolution to meet the commercial needs. 5G frame structures have the ability to provide sufficient flexibility for diverse use cases, deployments, spectrums and device capabilities. Currently, the frame structure in commercial network is DL-dominate. in the view of the fact that several use cases in vertical industries are UL unbalanced, this paper analysis a new uplink dominate frame structure in terms of latency and throughput. The simulation results show the uplink performance can be significantly improved by uplink dominate frame structure.

articleTitle: A Segment List Selection Algorithm Based on Delay in Segment Routing
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Segment Routing is increasingly being used in net- work traffic scheduling, while the number of delay-sensitive services in the network is increasing. However, calculating a segment list based on bandwidth alone is not good enough for scheduling experiment-sensitive services. In this paper, we calculate a segment list with delay guarantee effect in two steps. In the first step, an auxiliary graph is constructed by extracting some of the nodes in the network to reduce the network topology complexity, and in the second step, the segment list is calculated by Bellman–Ford algorithm based on the auxiliary graph and the link weights derived from the delay algorithm. We also construct a test environment based on Programming Protocol-independent Packet Processors (P4) to verify that the segment list generation algorithm proposed in this paper can optimize the delay of traffic.

articleTitle: The Common Ancestor Time Estimation of SARS-CoV-2 Based on Phylogenetic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At the end of 2019, a novel coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 was first identified in Wuhan, Hubei Province, China. So far, the virus has spread globally. The rapid transmission and mutation have undoubtedly increased the difficulty of exploring the source of SARS-CoV-2, and it has made the origins study meaningful. This study uses 40,280 SARS-CoV-2 genetic sequences from the world for phylogenetic analysis. It is inferred that the time to Most Recent Common Ancestor (tMRCA) of global SARS-CoV-2 is roughly in early December 2019. Similarly, the tMRCA of SARS-CoV-2 in each continent is estimated, and sort out the timeline of the virus’s entry into human society. Also, it is found that some regions outside Asia have COVID-19 cases in December 2019.

articleTitle: Parallel Clustering for Interference Alignment with Max-Min Fairness in Hybrid Data Center Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Data center networks (DCNs) are the essential infrastructure for cloud data centers, while the contradiction between the fixed topology and nonuniform distribution of traffic are causing the coexisting of network congestions and low network utilization in traditional wired DCNs. Thus the hybrid DCNs emerge as an alternative solution to construct flexible wireless topologies according to the dynamic traffic demands. By using wireless links, the DCN’s resource oversubscription problem can be alleviated and the network energy efficiency can be greatly improved. However, due to the dense deployment of wireless access points (APs) in hybrid DCNs, the interference among APs is an obstacle to the wireless network capacity. In this paper a novel clustering scheme for interference alignment (IA) is proposed to guarantee the max-min fairness of APs in the hybrid DCN. Each AP pair is allowed to join in multiple parallel IA clusters, if those clusters are allocated with orthogonal segmented resource, such as orthogonal frequency bands or time slots. The allocated resource proportion for each parallel cluster is determined by solving a linear max-min optimization problem. For the fully connected J user M × M MIMO IC, the max-min normalized degree of freedom (DoF) by parallel clustering is proven to be (2M-1)/J, while for the partially connected IC, we focused on the 2 × 2 case and proposed a heuristic algorithm to find all potential clusters for resource allocation optimization. Theoretical analysis and simulation results have validated that the proposed parallel clustering scheme can achieve better maxmin normalized DoF performance than the single user MIMO and traditional singular IA clustering schemes.

articleTitle: Fully-Supervised Semantic Segmentation Networks: Exploring the Relationship between the Segmentation Networks Learning Ability and the Number of Convolutional Layers
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The deeper the network, the more computing resources are needed, especially for semantic segmentation networks. We only know that within a certain range, the more convolutional layers, the better, but we don't know whether the number of convolutional layers in the backbone network has met the needs of segmentation tasks and whether the learning ability of the shallow networks is fully exploited. In this paper, we first propose to introduce the hyper-parameters of the number of convolutional layers into the deep learning training task. Based on prior knowledge, we design the loss-weight of the depth supervision branches in the basic semantic segmentation that has a linear function or a quadratic function relationship with the number of convolutional layers. The deep supervision layer is used as a tool to output the loss of the convolutional layer at different positions during the training process, and it becomes invalid during the test process. For the medium size networks, the method we designed improves the MIoU score of the PSV and CamVid data sets by an average of 1.37% and 0.94 % with Lovasz-Softmax loss function, respectively. Our approaches get significant improvement on shallow networks with MIoU scores by nearly 1% and 8% on the PSV dataset and the CamVid dataset respectively. Experimental results on the Cityscapes and CamVid datasets also show that by using deep supervision branches with loss weights, the learning ability of the model can be stably improved without increasing model parameters and without changing the model's backbone network structure.

articleTitle: Research on an Cascade Failure Model of Improved Scale-Free Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to resist the cascading failure phenomenon that often occurs in real networks and to enhance the reliability of the network, combined with the improved scale-free network, a cascading failure model with adjustable parameters is constructed. In this model, combining node degree information and node betweenness information and introducing the proportional parameters of the two, are α and β respectively, redefine the initial load and set the different proportional relationship between node load and node capacity. In view of the load spread of failed nodes, the maximum load capacity allocation mechanism is quickly developed and then through the analysis of the network cascade failure, the evolution process of the load parameters is deduced, and the influence of the parameters in the model on the robustness of the network is obtained. Finally, experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: KMRE: An Efficient and Compatible Runtime to Execute Android Application on Linux System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Porting Android applications to the Linux operating system is an important yet effective way to meet the needs of Linux users for Android applications in various scenarios such as office, education and entertainment. Previous methods were unable to reconcile compatibility and performance, and their user experiences were far from satisfactory. Consequently, in this paper, we present KMRE, a Mobile Runtime Environment which aims to run Android applications on the host Linux system. By porting the entire Android platform architecture onto Linux, KMRE achieves the efficient execution of Android applications and seamless information interaction between Android applications and Linux. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with state-of-the-art tools, KMRE shows the most comprehensive functionality while ensuring great performance.

articleTitle: Guiding Points Sampling-Based Large-Scale Evolutionary Multi-Objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: It is especially hard to search along the correct directions to generate promising offspring solutions in the large-scale decision space by using evolutionary algorithms. To tackle this problem, a guiding points-based sampling strategy for large-scale multi-objective optimization is proposed. First, guiding points are updated by the combination of the historical information and a set of candidate solutions which are the closest to the ideal point in the decision space. Then, a two-stage sampling strategy i.e. convergence-related sampling strategy and diversity-related sampling strategy is performed by the assistance of guiding points. To be specific, the convergence-related sampling strategy leverages the distance relationships between guiding points and candidate solutions to enhance the convergence. Furthermore, the diversity-related sampling strategy considers the distribution relationships between guiding points to promote the diversity for the next generation population. Experimental results on nine large-scale multi-objective optimization benchmark problems show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Lane Structure Fitting via Row-wise Grid Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With people’s attention to driving safety, the development of Advanced Driving Assistance System (ADAS) is becoming more and more mature, and lane detection is a vital part of it. Although most of the lane detection work based on deep learning shows excellent performance, in practical application, we should pursue a better balance between accuracy and speed. Shadow, blur and sparse supervision are still the challenges of lane detection. In this paper, we design a light convolutional neural network (CNN) based on ResNet-18, which achieves the fastest running time under the benchmark of ensuring detection accuracy. Different from the segmentation based method, we use the row-wise grid classification method, which can greatly reduce the amount of calculation. In addition, we propose a loss function with curve fitting function as reference value, which can maintain the lane structure and improve the problem of no visual information. Our model is tested on the TuSimple and CULane datasets. The experimental results show that our method is astonishing in accuracy and speed compared with the existing state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: 3D Real-time Face Acupoints Recognition System Based on HoloLens 2
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Acupoints positioning is a significant part of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) massage. However, the number of acupoints are large and their functions are complex, trainees usually need the guidance of doctors to accurately locate them. In order to improve the efficiency of acupoints location, this paper proposes a three-dimensional (3D) real-time face acupoints recognition system based on HoloLens 2. Through wearing the mixed reality device HoloLens 2, users can directly see the acupoints stacked on the human face. In this paper, we use a new face tracking technology, combined with landmark detection and acupoints positioning method in Acupoint Science to detect and track 3D facial acupoints in real time, and realize visualization on HoloLens 2. The positioning error of our system is about 2.55 mm and the frame rate is 20.59 FPS. The experimental results show that our system has good real-time and accuracy, can realize the automatic positioning of acupoints, and is conducive to the teaching and practice of TCM massage theory.

articleTitle: A Simplified Beamforming Assisted SM-MIMO Scheme with Blind Linear Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a simplified beamforming assisted spatial modulation multiple input multiple output (SM-MIMO) scheme with blind linear detection is developed, termed as SBF-BLD. With the proposed SBF-BLD, the transmitter in SM-MIMO system performs beamforming with very simplified maximum ratio transmission (MRT) criterion and the receiver adopts blind linear selective combing detector. Specifically, with the proposed scheme, the receiver could do very simple linear detection without the channel information, which can simplify the detector significantly and achieve very closed performance to maximum likelihood detection (MLD), especially under massive MIMO configuration. We present the analytical performance of SBF-BLD scheme both in small-scale and large-scale MIMO systems in this paper. Besides the advantage of complexity, simulation results show the significant performance gain of the proposed SBF-BLD than conventional SM and it also outperforms some conventional CSI assisted counterparts in SM-MIMO systems.

articleTitle: Visibility Prediction Based On XGBoost And Markov Chain Combined Model
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Improving the accuracy of visibility prediction is conducive to taking corresponding measures for weather with different visibility to achieve the purpose of ensuring the safety of life and property. Meteorological factors, environmental factors, terrain and human activities all have an impact on visibility. At present, visibility prediction mainly includes meteorological map analysis, numerical model forecasting, statistical forecasting and other methods. This paper proposes a visibility prediction based on Extreme Gradient Boosting and Markov chain combined model (MC-XGBoost). Firstly, build the MC-XGBoost model, the visibility related feature parameters are selected as the input of the model, and the corresponding visibility is taken as the output of the model. Then perform model training, adjust the model parameters to make the model achieve the optimal prediction effect. Finally, the trained model is applied to visibility prediction. Experimental results show that MC-XGBoost model can effectively predict visibility with high accuracy. This model can be used to predict visibility, which provides a certain reference value for the construction of a visibility prediction model in the future.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Model of Demolished Houses based on Improved Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In view of the problem of housing price evaluation, the traditional methods are not objective and efficient, which often stimulate the contradictions of various stakeholders, and even cause social chaos. This paper proposes an evaluation model of demolished houses based on improved deep learning, applies the theory of deep learning to the evaluation of demolished houses, optimizes and improves it, adds forgetting unit to it, and constructs regional factor index system, individual factor index system and transaction based index system. In this paper, a residential area in Shenyang is taken as the evaluation object, and the experiment shows that the proposed method improves the evaluation efficiency of demolished houses and reduces the subjective factors in the evaluation process.

articleTitle: Demand-based Scheduling with Sum-rate Maximization for Multiuser Multibeam Satellite Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A key requirement for the future multibeam satellite system is the ability to adapt to ever-increasing traffic demands by assigning resources to users in different beams with uneven traffic distributions. Most of related researches focus on the perspective of maximum throughput, while, ignoring the perspective of traffic demand. In this paper, we propose a new user scheduling algorithm named demand-based scheduling with sum-rate maximization (DBS-SM) that makes a balance between user traffic demand and the offered capacity. On the one hand, it can meet different user traffic demand to guarantee the fairness between users, on the other hand, maximizing the sum rate in the premise of satisfying user demand. Simulation results prove the effectiveness of the proposed scheduling algorithm and show the advantages over traditional scheduling algorithms.

articleTitle: Resource Optimization Algorithm for Task Offloading with Predicted Congestion
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To meet the needs of autonomous driving, the intensive computation tasks of vehicles can be quickly accomplished by offloading to roadside units (RSUs) by deploying RSUs at the edge of the road. In this paper, we study the task offloading problem of a traffic congestion scenario, and we employ a combination of congestion prediction and Q-learning to generate task offloading decisions. A car-following model is introduced to predict congestion, so potential traffic congestion can be detected in advance, thus avoiding the shortage of offloading resources in the congested road segments and improving the network performance. Simulation results show that the overall offloading delay of this algorithm is better than offloading to the nearest RSUs.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Query Optimization Based on HBase
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the advent of the big data era, higher technical requirements have been put forward for the management and retrieval of massive data. As a distributed NoSQL database under the Hadoop framework, HBase has been chosen by many companies as the storage medium for big data due to its strong scalability, excellent storage capabilities, and good read and write capabilities. However, HBase uses the Map-Reduce framework to process aggregate queries, which requires Calculate in real time and cannot keep the calculated result. This paper is dedicated to the research of query optimization technology based on HBase. In order to improve the efficiency of HBase for time series data aggregation and query, an index structure based on time split tree is proposed. The query overhead of tree index stored on disk is high and the query time is high. For problems affected by the amount of data, the time division tree structure is improved, and the query algorithm is optimized at the same time to avoid the disk I/O overhead of traversing the index tree layer by layer. First, save the time summary information, that is, the fixed-length data aggregation information, by constructing a time split tree; then persist the time split tree index into HBase according to the set time, add the corresponding timing information, and construct the sequence number, timing number, The HBase primary key of time range information; using time sequence information, through optimized index query algorithms, it can effectively narrow the data table retrieval range and improve the efficiency of aggregated information query. The effectiveness of the improved method is proved by a large number of wind farm wind turbine operating data.

articleTitle: Identification of Key Nodes in Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Identification of key nodes in network is of great significance in practical application. Some of the existing importance evaluation indexes have the defects of limited scope of application and incomplete evaluation results. Considering that the importance of nodes in complex networks is not only affected by a single factor, this paper proposes a key node identification algorithm based on multi-attribute weighted fusion (KNIA-MWF). We quantitatively analyze the influence of different attributes on nodes and assign the index weights by the combination of objective entropy weight method (EWM) and subjective analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to obtain the final topological importance (FTI) of each node which represents its structural importance. This algorithm can not only be used to identify the key nodes of different types of complex networks, but also be easy to be extended. Experimental results of removing key nodes in five kinds of networks show that KNIA-MWF can accurately identify the critical nodes in complex networks.

articleTitle: Old Wine in A New Bottle: A Homogeneous Fraud Sites Discovery Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Internet fraud is a serious threat to the normal order of the Internet, endangering the personal and property safety of its users. Nowadays in China, the most rampant forms of Internet fraud include false winning, false part-time job review, false investment, and phishing websites. Fraud gangs rely on overseas infrastructure and multiple domain names to evade domestic investigation. Meanwhile, they use common open source templates to build such apps or websites to save cost, which enables fast fabrication of apps/websites for various fraud scenarios with limited modifications. In this way, those low cost apps/websites are highly homogeneous in terms of page elements, in other words, "Old Wine in New Bottles". This paper presents a framework that combines both passive and active means for detection of such homogeneous apps/websites from raw Internet traffic. It is a synthesis of rapid detection, convergent verification, and feedback iteration. Having been deployed and verified on an ISP-level backbone in China, the framework is proved to be featured with high detection efficiency, low false-positive rate, and agility of updates.

articleTitle: Time and Position Aware Graph Neural Networks for Session-based Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Session-based recommendation system is an important part of many e-commerce sites. Its purpose is to recommend according to the interaction behavior of anonymous users in a short time. The latest research is to model the session sequence as a graph and then use the graph neural network to learn the embedding of the item. However, these methods treat the session as a simple sequence and ignore the time interval between user’s adjacent interactions. In order to solve this problem, we propose a Time and Position Aware Graph Neural Networks model for the session-based recommendation systems, which can not only learn the embedding of items, but also capture users' interest by using the time interval and sequence information when users browse items. We have conducted sufficient experiments on two e-business datasets, and the experimental results show that our model is superior to baselines.

articleTitle: On Adaptive Network Deployment for Visible Light Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This work studies adaptive network deployment for visible light communications (VLC), which exploit light wave as signal bearers. In most of the current literature, the VLC user is served by a single access point (AP), called serial transmission. To enhance network flexibility, parallel transmission (PT) was developed for VLC, enabling the user to be served by multiple APs simultaneously. Specifically, each AP consists of different coloured light-emitting diodes (LEDs) and modulates only one of them to mitigate inter-cell interference. The receiver, equipped with wavelength division concentrators, can distinguish signals carried by different wavelengths. To further improve network flexibility, adaptive network deployment is proposed in this paper, by allowing the APs to modulate a dynamic number of LEDs. The adaptive scheme is comprised of three modes of network deployment, and the mode selection is formulated as an optimisation problem to maximise network capacity with proportional fairness. Results show that compared with the original PT method, the new scheme can significantly improve network throughput, especially with an increase of up to 40% for room corner users.

articleTitle: Dynamic Scheduling Algorithm Based on Random Distribution for Mimic Defense System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: DHR architecture could address threats from unknown vulnerabilities and backdoors effectively without prior knowledge. Compared to traditional defense techniques, the security of DHR is based on its dynamic and heterogeneous nature. In this paper, we discuss refining the scheduling algorithm to improve the dynamic and heterogeneous nature of the DHR architecture and propose the RDWC algorithm based on random distribution and weighting coefficients. Simulation shows that the algorithm can significantly reduce the average execution time of variants containing vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Analysis and Classification of Job Multiple Characteristics on Supercomputers
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
