abstract: The diversity and complexity of applications grow, with the development of HPC systems. In-depth investigation and study of the job characteristics are critical for system optimization, management and application optimization. Our study in the paper strives to explore some important characteristics based on long-term historical data. We get many useful insights and findings about runtime distribution, job status and I/O behaviors. Besides, we present a grouping method to classify the jobs into different groups. Evaluations about the runtime and I/O prove that jobs with similar names have similar characteristics.

articleTitle: A hybrid AES encryption for IOT using Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: AES is one of the most commonly used methods to encrypt data for Internet of things(IOT). However, the encryption process usually complies with determined rules and fixed keys, once the keys are exposed to the attackers, they can effectively carry out correlation analysis attacks by reverse decryption. In this work, we proposed to integrate Generative adversarial Network (GAN) into inner layer of AES for better encryption. As the GAN generated encryption is not based on determined rules and it needs learning process to encoding and decoding. Therefore, it provides more security facing reverse cracking. Experiments prove the effectiveness of our proposal.

articleTitle: Squaring and Long Coherent Integration Codeless Tracking Algorithm of GPS Authorized Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Quality monitoring of GNSS authorized signals is an important research field. In this paper, squaring and long coherent integration codeless tracking algorithm is proposed to monitor the Doppler frequency of authorized signals. We firstly analyze the signal and noise power after squaring and coherent integration of GPS L1 C/A and P(Y) multi-component signal with a phase difference of 90°. Then squaring and long coherent integration codeless tracking with traditional loop filtering algorithm (such as phase locked loop, frequency locked loop and frequency locked loop assisted phase locked loop) and with Kalman filtering algorithm are proposed to track Doppler frequency of authorized signals. The effectiveness of the proposed codeless architecture is demonstrated using real data collected from GPS satellites. The results supports the validity of the proposed architecture which enables quality monitoring of authorized GPS signals.

articleTitle: A Digital Parallel Receiver Structure Based On Frequency Domain Symbol Synchronization and Feedback Frequency Domain Equalization
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As the symbol rate of the communication system increases, the received signal must be demodulated in parallel. Compared with time domain parallel demodulator, frequency domain parallel demodulator consumes fewer resources. This paper proposes a practical digital parallel receiver structure, including frequency domain symbol synchronization and feedback frequency domain equalization. The Barton algorithm is used to estimate the timing error for symbol synchronization in the frequency domain. Based on the frame structure with the Chu sequence, the channel frequency response can be estimated to update the equalizer coefficients for the next frame in quasi-static channel. The simulation proves that the proposed structure can effectively resist multipath fading under sampling clock offset.

articleTitle: An Optimation on Iterative Weighing Coefficient of Three Dimensional Turbo Product Code
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose three categories of iterative decoding structures of three-dimensional(3-D) turbo product code(TPC), which is based on soft-input-soft-output(SISO) iterative decoding algorithm. Then by weighing the bit-error-rate(BER) curves of the 3-D TPC serial iterative decoder, a hybrid form of serial and parallel decoder and the parallel iterative decoder, and an optimal iterative decoding scheme is emerged. Furthermore, via adjusting the iterative weighing coefficient of the extrinsic information and equilibrating the proportion between the extrinsic information and the received information while decoding, the soft information of each bit is continuously modified to increase its reliability, delivering better decoding performance. Moreover, based on the enhanced structure of the 3-D TPC parallel iterative algorithm, we test different kinds of combinations of weighing coefficient, and pick out the best choice to achieve the lowest BER. Simulation results show that the performance of the modified 3-D TPC parallel decoder is substantially augmented under the circumstance of 3dB signal noise ratio(SNR) and 0.706 code rate, where the BER is quite close to the Shannon limit. under where its BER is almost approaching 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup>, which meets the BER requirements in modern wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: ℓ2,1-norm minimization for Unsupervised Feature Selection from Incomplete Data
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Unsupervised feature selection (UFS) has been widely used in many machine learning applications, since it can alleviate burdens on the curse of high dimensional data. However, existing works design the UFS methods with the assumption that the complete information of dataset can be observed. In this paper, we propose a UFS method from incomplete data by further introducing ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,1</inf>-norm minimization. In order to exploit feature relevance for UFS, we show that ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,1</inf>-norm minimization should be elaborately dealt with unobserved information, which can be finely described with the use of an indicator matrix. The proposed ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,1</inf>-norm minimization UFS from incomplete data (LUFS) can be directly solved by a convex optimization problem, and we design an alternative algorithm to optimize the convex problem, where the convergence of LUFS algorithm is also proved theoretically and experimentally. Empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of LUFS with the state-of-the-art methods on real incomplete datasets.

articleTitle: A Method for Suppressing the Fluctuation of Aircraft Taxiing Posture
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Illumination variation in the scene, random noise in imaging, video blurring caused by encoding and decoding, which cause a certain degree of random fluctuations between the taxiing posture of aircraft detected from video and the actual taxiing posture in the scene. This paper proposes a method for suppressing the fluctuation of aircraft taxiing posture. The method firstly uses the background subtraction (Vibe) to extract the region of target, and obtain the initial position of the taxiing posture, then the Kalman filter is used to predict the taxiing trajectory of the initial position, the random fluctuations are suppressed to obtain a smooth estimate of the position in the taxiing posture, finally, obtain the speed and direction of the taxiing posture according to the smooth estimated position, output the taxiing posture based on the image plan. the actual test at the airport shows that the method in this paper has a center ability to restrain the fluctuation of taxiing aircraft posture.

articleTitle: Leakage Minimization Based Precoding for Multibeam Satellite Communications with Phase Noise and Carrier Frequency Offset
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We investigated precoding methods under different interference scenes for multi-beam satellite communication systems. We introduced the application of precoding in the MIMO system, and analyzed the similarity between the terrestrial MIMO system and the satellite communication system, and introduced the precoding technology to the satellite system. We first derived the satellite communication system model and gave the channel fading model. Then we raised the precoding methods of minimizing the average leakage power in two scenes that considered only the phase noise and considered both phase noise and carrier frequency offset respectively. The simulation results show that the precoding methods to minimize the average leakage power can achieve good performance in two different scenes and greatly reduce algorithm complexity.

articleTitle: A Text-to-Image Generation Method Based on Multiattention Depth Residual Generation Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we focus on generating realistic images from text descriptions. The current methods mainly use stacked networks, and there are two main problems. (1) The text information is relatively complicated, and it is difficult for the convolutional layer to extract deep-level text features. So the text features often can’t guide the generation of images effectively, which leads to a lower degree of matching between the generated image and the text; (2) The quality of the generated images is poor, and the authenticity, vividness and diversity of the images need to be improved. In this article, we propose a multi-attention depth residual generation adversarial network (MADR-GAN) based on the DM-GAN model to generate high-quality images. The network proposes a deep residual self-attention mechanism (DRSAM) in the low-resolution image generation stage, which is utilized to lift deep-level text information features and improve the quality of initial generated images. In the high-resolution image refinement stage, the CBAM attention mechanism is introduced to enhance the quality of high-resolution image generation. We evaluate the DM-GAN model on the Caltech-UCSD Birds 200 dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that our MADR-GAN model performs favorably against the state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Research on Space-Time Block Code Technology in MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: MIMO technology has been widely used in the telecommunication systems nowadays, and the space-time coding is a key part of MIMO technology. A good coding scheme can exploit the spatial diversity to correct the error which is generated in transmission, and increase the normalized transfer rate with low decoding complexity. On the Basis of the research on different Space-Time Block Codes, this essay proposes a new STBC, Diagonal Block Orthogonal Space-Time Block Code. Then we will compare it with other STBCs in the performance of bit error rate, transfer rate, decoding complexity and peek-to-average power ratio, the final result will prove the superiority of DBOAST.

articleTitle: Lip Reading Based on 3D Face Modeling and Spatial Transformation Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Lip reading is the task of obtaining text information from a video without audio, which is of great significance for speech recognition when audio is damaged. Lip reading mainly needs to extract the appearance features and movement information of the speakers' lips. Lip reading based on deep learning has achieved much progress at present, but the lip deflection caused by the camera angle still affects the accuracy of lip reading. This paper has researched reducing the effect of camera angle on lip reading. We use 3D face alignment to obtain spatial depth information, and color attributes to modulate depth information to add the missing information due to pose changes. And at the same time, we use deformable convolution to learn spatial position transformation. The methods are verified on the TCD-TIMIT dataset, which has two camera angles: straight and 30°. The accuracy of lip reading on the 30° camera angle dataset can be significantly improved, with an accuracy close to the accuracy on the straight angle dataset. At the same time, the accuracy of lip reading on the straight camera angle dataset is also promoted. It proves the effectiveness of the method in this paper to weaken the effect of camera angle on lip reading.

articleTitle: Effect Evaluation of Network Protection Based on Fuzzy-AHP
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to accurately evaluate the effect of network protection, this paper presents an effect evaluation model based on Fuzzy-AHP. The model presents the evaluation index system of network protection effect, and uses the method of fuzzy analytic hierarchy process to calculate the index weight, and finally uses the weighted average method to calculate the result of the evaluation. The elementary test and calculation results show that the model can be in all reason utilized to measure the actual network protection effect.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Supervised Anonymous Cross-domain Authentication Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of the network environment, the traditional authentication technology has exposed its disadvantages such as low efficiency and power concentration. At the same time, the continuous development of information technology also puts forward higher requirements for authentication technology, for example, to realize authentication anonymization while ensuring authentication efficiency and dishonest users can be held accountable. In this paper, cross-domain authentication of heterogeneous networks is analyzed in detail, and a Blockchain-based Supervised Anonymous Cross-domain Authentication (BSA-CA) scheme is proposed. In this scheme, we retain the original infrastructure of the two trust domains. The trust network of users is established in the Blockchain system, and the trust model of heterogeneous cross-domain authentication is constructed by using zero-knowledge proof method. The BSA-CA scheme uses group signature to design anonymous supervisory properties. System analysis results show that the BSA-CA scheme has a good balance between security and authentication efficiency.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Hybrid Beamforming for Intelligent Reflecting Surface Aided Communication Systems with One-Bit DACs
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this work, we consider a millimeter-wave multiple input single output communication system assisted with the intelligent reflecting surface (IRS). Due to the prohibitive hardware cost and power consumption, the hybrid beamforming scheme is introduced with low resolution digital-to-analog converters (DACs) at the base station. The achievable sum rate is maximized by separately designing the hybrid beamforming and the IRS phase shift matrix. Because of non-convexity, the hybrid beamforming is developed by designing the analog and digital beamfomers independently. Considering the information of the hybrid beamforming might not be known at IRS, we use the statistical information and develop a practical IRS matrix without knowing hybrid beamforming. Simulation results illustrate that this performance exceeds the benchmark with infinite-resolution DACs at low power, and validates its feasibility with low-resolution DACs. Additionally, the low complexity of the proposed method is also verified via complexity order and runtime.

articleTitle: The Design of Holistic Vulnerability Measure Method Integrated with Topological Properties and Security Capabilities for Smart Grid Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve the overall security operation of smart grid, this paper designs a holistic vulnerability measure method for smart grid control system that integrated with its topology properties and security protection capabilities. More detailed, the method can intensively assess its vulnerability through the featured indexes, i.e., the inherent topological vulnerability indexes in terms of the local uniformity and global imbalance rooted from the internetworking of smart grid control system, the interdependent vulnerability indexes induced from power grid in terms of electrical centrality of power nodes, and the intrinsic security defects stemmed from smart grid control system in terms of the attacking effectiveness. Besides, this paper implements its vulnerability situation visualization by radar map, and computes a weighted value to effectively evaluate its holistic vulnerability. Finally, through a case of the smart grid IEEE14-bus, this paper verifies the effectiveness of the proposed vulnerability metrics and the measuring method. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Ultra-wide band OAM Antenna Based on Circular Phased-array Conical Dielectric Resonator
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of spectrum resource shortage and low spectrum utilization, an ultra-wideband OAM conical array antenna operating in a millimeter-wave band based on the annular phased array model is proposed in this paper. The conical array antenna is obtained by rotating 12 conical dielectric resonator antenna units clockwise along the z-axis with equal amplitude and a constant phase difference between adjacent units, and the phase difference between two adjacent antenna units is 30°. It is experimentally demonstrated that the antenna can produce ±1±2±3±4±5 vortices in both Ku, K and Ka bands with a relative bandwidth of 75.7%.

articleTitle: Study on Costs of Software-based Heterogeneous Redundant Execution
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Software-based redundant execution (SRE) is a popular fault-tolerant design method which makes use of faults occurring randomly. Software-based heterogeneous redundant execution (SHRE) uses heterogeneous redundant software replicas with identical function based on SRE and diversity of software. By voting the results of heterogeneous redundant software replicas, SHRE can resist threats from software vulnerabilities and monoculture. SHRE resisting network attacks was proved to be reliable. The classification method of SHRE was proposed, and the costs analysis method of SHRE was introduced. Finally, the costs calculation process was taken as an example.

articleTitle: Robust Model Aggregation for Federated Learning with Heterogeneous Clients
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This Federated learning has received extensive attention in recent years due to its potential in mitigating risks of intruding privacy. However, most of existing methods don’t provide adequate consideration to the heterogeneity of client. Therefore these parameters are treated equally and aggregated with the same weight. As a result, the overall performance may be degraded because of straggling clients. In this paper, we propose an aggregation algorithm considering the accuracy of local model of heterogeneous clients. The server evaluates the accuracy of the uploaded local model with a benchmark dataset, and then updates model parameters according to the accuracy ratio. Experimental results show the model accuracy of our proposed method performs better than existing methods. At the same time, in the presence of noisy users, it can eliminate their effect by assigning lower aggregation weights to them.

articleTitle: Lightweight Stacked Hourglass Network for Efficient Robotic Arm Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Existing robotic arm pose estimation methods usually only focus on improving the accuracy of the model, but ignoring model efficiency, therefore the development of models with a large number of parameters and computation in practical use. To solve the problem, this paper proposes a new HetConv-Based Stacked Hourglass Network (HetConv-SHN). HetConv-SHN develops from the Stacked Hourglass Network (SHN), which constructs an SHN with two stacks, and compresses the model by replacing the standard convolution in the SHN with a lightweight HetConv (Heterogeneous Kernel-Based Convolution) module. Experiments conducted on four typical datasets demonstrate that HetConv-SHN can achieve better accuracy than its counterparts with fewer parameters and computation. It can be better deployed on robotic arms, enabling lightweight robotic arm pose estimation.

articleTitle: Improved Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Model
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The rise of Web 2.0 has brought about significant changes in online behavior patterns from users. Users are no longer just consumers of information, but the main producers of information. Behavioral information such as clicks and purchases will be recorded by the Internet. Therefore, user interaction data exploded at an exponential rate, leading to the problem of information overload, and the recommendation system is an effective strategy to solve this problem. In response to the above problems, this paper innovates on the basis of traditional recommendation algorithms and proposes an improved collaborative filtering recommendation model. Taking into account the different contributions of user historical interaction data to predicting the target product, the standard attention mechanism cannot play a good role due to the large difference in the length of user historical data. This paper proposes to introduce a smoothing parameter to improve this problem. At the same time, the paper introduces the residual network to learn nonlinear features to overcome the problem of network degradation in the deep network model and help improve the final recommendation result. This paper conducts experiments and evaluations on real public data sets, and compares the performance with current related models. Experiments have verified the rationality and effectiveness of the model design in this paper, and the recommendation accuracy has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm for Blind Source Separation Based on Independent Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Blind Source Separation (BSS) refers to the task of recovering the source signal from a known mixed signal (also called the observation signal). The core of BSS is to find a separation matrix W and Independent Component Analysis (ICA) has been intensively studied for BSS. However, when using traditional ICA, it is easy to fall into the local optimum and the convergence speed is slow. Moreover, the accuracy of speech separation remains inadequate. For this reason, we propose that Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm (GOA) is employed to search for the separation matrix W for the BSS in conjunction with the Negative Entropy maximization function. The results show that effective separation can be achieved by our method (GOA_BSS) for different types of data including the human speech and bird sounds in various scenarios considered. Specifically, Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) are used to compare with GOA. GOA is superior to the two algorithms in separation efficiency, separation stability, and convergence speed. In summary, GOA_BSS has achieved an efficient separation success rate (S-Rate) in the problem of BSS, and GOA_BSS has good generalization capability.

articleTitle: Beam Domain Oversampling with Pruned FFT for Virtual Massive MIMO in FDD Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO), with a large number of antennas, the spectral efficiency and energy efficiency can be dramatically enhanced at the cost of higher system complexity, power consumption and pilot overhead. To reduce the cost, the virtue massive MIMO is investigated, which equips only a small number of antennas at the base station and improves the performance by beam domain oversampling. However, in frequency division duplexing(FDD) system with codebook based precoding matrix, beam domain oversampling requires larger codebook size which will increase complexity for best precoding matrix search. In this paper, by exploiting the sparsity in both spatial and beam domain, a fast Fourier transform (FFT) pruning based precoding matrix searching algorithm is proposed which removes the unnecessary calculation branch in FFT to greatly reduce the complexity. Simulation results show that it has high efficiency and can achieve the similar performance of the traditional one with full FFT operation.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Based Hybrid-intelligence Multi-branch Wargaming
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Uncertainty of war challenges command decision making, especially in the pre-war preparation stage. In newly proposed operational concepts, uncertainty is taken as a means to limit the opponent's decision-making. How to help commanders analyze and utilize uncertainty has become a technical challenge that must be overcome to win the future combats. In this paper, a method called hybrid-intelligence multi-branch wargaming was proposed. Through combination of human intelligence in form of knowledge, and machine intelligence trained by reinforcement learning, the method realized new functions of COA evaluation and optimization analysis. Its feasibility and effectiveness has been verified through prototype development and experiments. It provides a short-term feasible way for the application of artificial intelligence technology in the field of command decision-making.

articleTitle: An AFSS-based Multipattern Reconfigurable 5G Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a geared directional reconfigurable antenna is designed for application in the 5G band. The antenna is based on an active frequency selective surface (AFSS), surrounded by an octagonal screen of AFSS cells, which uses the frequency-selective properties of its band-stopped AFSS to suppress the antenna surface waves and to concentrate further the radiated energy of the antenna in a particular direction of radiation. The on-state of the diode controls each AFSS unit to switch from the on-state (high transmission) to the off-state (high reflection), activating the corresponding AFSS unit, minimizing interference, and optimizing the use of media, which can direct the antenna's radiation in the desired direction. The antenna has a 360° omni-directional pattern reconfigurability.

articleTitle: A Greedy Strategy of Multiplexing uRLLC Traffic Within eMBB Services for HSR
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Ultra-reliable low latency communication (uRLLC) services are crucial for the safe operation of high-speed railways (HSRs). However, when multiplexing with enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB) traffics, the multiple types of uRLLC traffics pose a new challenge. To address the scheduling problem of physical resources in the coexistence of heterogeneous traffics, we divide uRLLC traffics into several levels based on the bit error rate (BER) and delay metrics. A latency margin-based physical resource multiplexing concept is proposed based on different allowable latencies of each traffics. Furthermore, we formulate an optimization problem to minimize the total power of uRLLC traffics while guaranteeing the BER and latency requirements, and a greedy strategy is proposed to solve this optimization problem efficiently. The simulation results show that our proposal can not only guarantee the BER and latency requirements but also reduce the power consumption of various uRLLC traffics significantly in the cases of poor channel status, enhancing the safety and reliability of train-ground wireless communication greatly.

articleTitle: A Survey on Methodologies and Techniques for IPv6 Network Alias Resolution
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the promotion and use of IPv6 worldwide, the demand of research on IPv6 alias resolution is increasing. Understanding and resolving aliases in IPv6 addresses is vital on research of IPv6. In this paper, we discuss the definition of alias address and alias prefix. By classifying, organizing, and summarizing the alias resolution algorithms, we analyze the advantages and disadvantages of each algorithm in detail and discuss the various challenges they face. In the end, we point out the problems that should be paid attention to in future research in aliasing target set selection and inference method in alias resolution algorithms.

articleTitle: Adaptive Kalman Filter with Strong Tracking for Train Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the next generation of train control system, high speed train position system consists of seveval positioning methods. For example, beidou satellite, inertial navigation, speed sensor and balise position. The train integrated system use different sensors to collect data for the safety redundancy. The data is unsynchronized and uneven, also delay,loss and disturb happened in data transmission, so the research of non-uniform data filtering and fusion algorithm is needed. The paper proposed a new multi-rate robust nonlinear filtering algorithm (named SH-STF algorithm) based on SH and STF algorithms. The SH-STF algorithm not only has good robustness of SH algorithm, but also has strong tracking performance of STF algorithm. Theoretical analysis, simulation results and Fuxin-Shenyang railway field tests verify the effectiveness of the new algorithm can reduce positioning error and increase real time performance.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Deep Neural Network for Wideband Power Amplifier Behavioral Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a bidirectional gated recurrent deep neural network (BGDNN) for PA behavioral modeling. Since bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BGRU) has strong representtative ability for the temporal features of PA output signals, BGRU is utilized in BGDNN to extract all available temporal information including the long and short memory information, causal and non-causal relationships of PA signals, and it is in line with the representation of the physical distortion characteristic of PA. In addition, fully connected deep neural network layer is subsequently applied in BGDNN to integrate deep features and transform the output of BGRU to a dimension that is more conductive to express PA's nonlinear characteristic. Extensive simulations verify that BGDNN outperforms other recent RNN-based PA behavioral modeling methods.

articleTitle: Design of Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna Based on Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Metasurface has unique electromagnetic properties, and by combining with a frequency reconfigurable antenna and rotating the metasurface around the center of the microstrip patch antenna in a mechanical manner, it is possible to change the operating frequency and operating frequency band of the antenna continuously. To study the effect of metasurface on antenna performance, a design of frequency reconfigurable microstrip patch antenna based on metasurface is proposed in this paper. This antenna consists of the metasurface, microstrip patch antenna, where both layers of the circular dielectric substrate with the radius of 20mm, the thickness of 1.524mm, and dielectric constant of 3.48 Rogers 4350B. Metasurface unit placed directly above the microstrip patch antenna unit consists of elliptical patches placed periodically in the vertical and horizontal directions. The operating frequency of the antenna is about 5GHz, and by rotating the metasurface around the central metal rod of the microstrip patch antenna. The continuous offset can be achieved in the operating band (S11<-10dB) 4.83GHz-5.64GHz, and the offset is about 810MHz, making the same antenna work in different frequency bands, and the E-plane, H-plane and 3D radiation gain are more significant than 6dB, which is of Critical research significance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Satellite Interference Source Location Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: There are many methods and principles of satellite interference source location, but no matter which method is chosen, the positioning equation is nonlinear. Therefore, it is very important to solve the nonlinear equations accurately for the accuracy of the final positioning results. In this paper, an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is proposed. Based on the combination of PSO and grid search algorithm, the precision requirement is set in the iterative stop condition. When the calculation results meet the set precision, iteration can be stopped. Compared with the ordinary particle swarm optimization algorithm, the results can be obtained more quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Construction of Perfect Gaussian Integer Sequences with High Energy Efficiency Based on Difference Sets
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: the perfect Gaussian integer sequence (PGIS) can not only suppress interference but also obtain higher transmission rates and spectrum efficiency when it is applied to a communication system. However, its unequal amplitude characteristics will result in a peak-to-average ratio (PAPR) of signal transmission. Therefore, this paper studies the parameter conditions of PGIS with high energy efficiency based on the difference set, revealing the fact that the real and imaginary parts of the PGIS will form a four-valued periodic complementary pair (PCP). Compared with the existing literature, this method can directly obtain a large number of PGIS with rich lengths and energy efficiency close to 1, which greatly reduces the PAPR of the communication system.

articleTitle: Verifiable RFID Location Privacy Scheme Based on NIZK
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Radio frequency identification technology (RFID) is widely used due to its advantages of contactless identification. How to ensure the location privacy of tags and their users has become an urgent problem in the development of RFID technology. In order to resist active attacks such as tampering and counterfeiting caused by rewriting encryption and canceling encryption by malicious attackers. According to the existing location privacy protection schemes, this paper uses non-interactive zero-knowledge proof (NIZK) and universal re-encryption, then designs a publicly verifiable location privacy re-encryption scheme. In this scheme, all calculations are performed by the anonymizer. The anonymizer not only performs the ciphertext re-randomization operation, but also needs to provide a NIZK for this. The next anonymizer must verify the proof before re-randomization. The tag only needs to provide a certain reading and writing function to ensure that the ciphertext re-randomized each time will not be tampered with. We can see that this scheme can well protect the tag and user's location privacy through analysis.

articleTitle: Modulation Division based User Grouping Communication for Massive SIMO in IIoT
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a modulation division based user grouping communication scheme is proposed for massive single- input multiple-output (SIMO) in industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), in which the base station (BS) is equipped with a large number of antennas, and a number of single-antenna users use the same time-frequency source to transmit signals to the BS. Considering the limited pilot sequences, the users are divided into several groups, and orthogonal pilot sequences are arranged to different groups, while users in the same group reuse the same pilot sequence. Meanwhile, a sum-constellation is uniquely divided into a group of sub-constellations for the users in the same group, which constitute an additive uniquely decomposable constellation group design (AUDCG). At the BS, the sum signal is firstly detected for the whole group and then the signal of each user is determined using the AUDCG design. Subject to power constraints, the user grouping algorithm is investigated to improve the average signal detection performance of all the groups. Computer simulation results show that the proposed communication system and user grouping algorithm achieve good performance.

articleTitle: Fire Detection Based on Infrared Filter and Deep Learing
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The use of video detection to detect fire has become an important research topic, which helps reduce personal and property losses. Detecting early fire helps prevent disaster, and the key factors for detecting fire are high accuracy, low false alarm rate, and fast response time. This paper uses infrared detection to improve the accuracy of fire detection, and at the same time uses convolutional neural networks to reduce the false alarm rate of detection. The detection performance of this model is better than some existing fire detection algorithms, and the algorithm model is deployed in the equipment, the function of real-time fire detection is realized.

articleTitle: A Class Attendance System Based on Cloud Face Recognition for Multi-users
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper introduces a class attendance system for multi-users. This system is based on an OpenCV image recognition module to design a face recognition application that can be used for check-in. OpenCV is used as the primary control recognition module to recognize and track the target face through image processing. Meanwhile, Baidu Cloud stores a face database and provides face recognition and matching scores for face images. This system builds on a client-server structure so that multiple users can use it in different classrooms to check-in at the same time. All faculties can use this for class attendance purposes at any place.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Detection of ECG with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of machine learning and deep learning, ECG intelligent detection models lean more heavily on the labeled data. However, the development of ECG annotation cannot satisfy the development of an intelligent detection model because of its high complexity and heavy workload. Developing a model with low dependence on labeled data becomes the core for solving the ECG intelligent detection. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes a deep active learning (DAL) model for ECG intelligent detection, which combines high-performance deep learning (DL) with active learning (AL) that is less dependent on labeled data. Experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve high performance with the support of a small amount of labeled data. The proposed method could be adopted for data annotation, which achieves a high-quality data annotation and avoids useless annotation.

articleTitle: HEP: Heuristic Similarity Calculation based on the Minimum Entropy Principle
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Automatically calculating the semantic similarity of two short sentences is one of the fundamental tasks in natural language processing. There are several models used to evaluate semantic similarity. However, most methods in unsupervised learning are still traditional models. In this paper, we propose a new approach that is in line with the law of nature. We use a minimum entropy weighted model based on the heuristic algorithm to perform this task. Instead of individual weigh vector for each sentence, searched a global weight that applies to all sentences. We choose accuracy and area under the curve (AUC) as evaluation metrics. By calculating the similarity of sentence pairs on different datasets, our minimum entropy weighted model outperforms previous traditional unsupervised models in accuracy and the area under the curve (AUC). This paper optimize the threshold selection in calculation and obtain an excellent experimental results in more general cases. All in all, this paper provides an excellent weighting method for word vectors to form sentence vectors.

articleTitle: Analysis of Self-assembly Cooperative Link Technology of Helicopter-borne UAV Bee
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to meet the communication needs of cooperative and networked combat, this paper analyzes the system multiple access system of drone swarm based on combing the advantages of helicopter drone swarm combat, proposes a synchronous network access method with carrier detection capability, studies the network architecture, puts forward a list of capabilities for application mode, topology and service type, and then plans the protocol stack of swarm network. Finally, it considers the working frequency band, time division multiple access system, modulation mode and distance transmission characteristics. And it is concluded that when the link level reserve is 6.45 dB, it can ensure the reliable transmission of self-assembled cooperative link of helicopter-borne UAV swarm.

articleTitle: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion via Total Variation and Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Owning to the different imaging principles of the infrared (IR) and visible images, IR images contain object information by thermal radiation and visible images contain abundant details of the scene. Image fusion can combine the complementary information of IR and visible image. To obtain ideal fusion result, we should consider the difference between multi-sensor images and use different representations for the source images. In this paper, a new total variation (TV) based fusion method for IR and visible image is proposed. Our method consists of two steps. First, we represent the fusion task as a L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>−L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> TV model. The fidelity term is formulated by L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> norm to constrain the fusion result preserving intensities in IR and visible images, and the regularization term is formulated by L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> norm to constrain the fusion result preserving gradients in visible image. Second, we adopt the framework alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) to solve the TV minimization problem. We take both qualitative and quantitative tests on our method, and make comparisons with eight state-of-the-art methods. The experimental results indicate that our method is superior to the other eight methods.

articleTitle: An Accurate Segmentation Method for Experimental Image of Cells
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Image segmentation is not only a basic problem in the field of image processing, but also in the field of biological data processing. In recent years, people have made a lot of efforts to improve the accuracy of segmentation. This paper proposes an image segmentation method based on generative adversarial networks to segment the images of human HT29 colon cancer cells. The network uses Unet as the generator network. The segmentation results of the human HT29 colon cancer cells image dataset show that compared with other methods, this method improves the average accuracy of image segmentation to 98.659%.

articleTitle: User Selection and Leakage-based Precoding for Coordinated Dual-satellite System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Inter-satellite coordination has been considered to meet the increasing throughput demand and reduce inter-satellite interference. And user selection is necessary since the users on the ground are far more than the available satellite antennas. However, the existing studies rarely investigate user selection for improving the capacity of the dual-satellite systems. Aiming at maximizing the capacity of the dual-satellite systems, we propose an efficient user selection algorithm. The two sets of users served by two satellites are selected from the candidate users based on the system capacity maximization. The intra-satellite and inter-satellite interference of the selected users are reduced by the precoding scheme which maximizes the signal-to-leakage-and-noise-ratio (SLNR). Simulation results show that our proposed algorithm has greater system capacity compared with the existing user selection algorithms and the leakage-based precoding is more suitable for satellite communication than ZF precoding.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Protection of Bamboo Tube based on Hani Nationality
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In today’s society, due to the lack of sufficient attention to the intangible cultural heritage of ethnic minorities, many classic cultures and technologies are gradually forgotten. Therefore, taking Hani bamboo tube as an example, this paper applies virtual reality technology to the protection of traditional crafts, which can make people have a comprehensive understanding of traditional crafts. In this paper, the virtual model of Hani bamboo tube is established and optimized; The three-dimensional model is established through a series of operations such as information collection, image processing, establishment and optimization of three-dimensional model. Finally, the three-dimensional interactive effect is improved through three-dimensional VR glasses display, so that the experimenters can personally experience the rich and colorful production process and use methods of Hani bamboo tube. Through the digital protection of Hani bamboo tube, it can provide reference for the protection and development of handicraft technology of other ethnic minorities.

articleTitle: Improvement of TFRC Congestion Control Algorithm Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Transmission Control Protocol Friendly Rate Control (TFRC), as a mechanism to implement User Datagram Protocol (UDP) congestion control, can share bandwidth resources friendly with Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) data streams. However, since it is still a connectionless transmission mode in nature, there are problems that congestion has occurred when the transmission rate is adjusted, and the curve changes too much when the channel is unstable. In order to improve these problems, this paper proposes a method of network change trend prediction based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). This method collects the packet loss rate in a certain period of time for neural network training, predicts the packet loss rate at a later time according to the input packet loss rate data, and converts the predicted data into the packet loss rate change trend to join the algorithm. The simulation experiment results show that the output curve with prediction has smaller change interval and smoother change trend compared with the output curve of the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Image Classification of Leaf Diseases Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the classification of plant leaf diseases, convolutional neural networks have problems such as single training dataset, time-consuming training and over-fitting. Firstly, part of the public datasets are selected and the network pictures are added to form a small sample mixed dataset to solve the problem of single dataset. At the same time, data enhancement technology is adopted to expand the dataset. Secondly, a variety of models are compared and the VGG16 model is selected as the basic model employed in this study. The transfer learning method is used to train the model to reduce training time and improve accuracy. Finally, the model is improved and fine-tuned, which greatly reduces the over-fitting phenomenon and has an accuracy rate of 98.79%.

articleTitle: An Optimized Algorithm of Balise Message Decoding
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The safe and efficient transmission of balise message is the key issue that needs to be solved in recent years. According to the FFFIS(Form Fit Function Interface Specification) coding strategy of the European Railway Signal Standards Organization, this paper designs a optimization strategy for balise message decoding. Different from the traditional decoding method, this algorithm can correctly decode the message and avoid a large number of repeated calculations in a strong noise environment, and is more suitable for hardware implementation. In addition, this paper also proposes a majority filtering algorithm to eliminate the influence of random noise in the transmission process. Simulation results show that: Using the decoding method in this paper will improve the decoding efficiency and accuracy in a strong noisy environment. The theoretical feasibility of this method is verified.

articleTitle: Near Field Electromagnetic Ranging in Low Frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Near field of transmitting and receiving loop antennas exhibited a low impedance wave in low frequency, which resulted a degradation of ranging accuracy as the distance and frequency changed. A hybrid near-field electromagnetic ranging (NFER) algorithm was proposed in conjunction with the electric-magnetic field impedance and phase difference. The near-field phase-only method was derived and evaluated which showed an increasing ranging error with lower frequency and short distance. The opposite situation existed in amplitude-only method. Considering ALPHA noise distribution, the weighting coefficients were investigated using correlation operation of electric and magnetic fields. Numerical results showed that the proposed method was capable, in principle, to achieve a high accuracy under the conditions of low SNR both in a wide range and a broad bandwidth. The hybrid algorithm reached optimal ranging accuracy with the boundary coefficient 0.3 when SNR was 10dB.

articleTitle: A CMOS Triple Cascode X-band Power Amplifier with Dual Feedback Based Active Linearizer
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A fully integrated broadband linear X-band power amplifier (PA) with high-efficiency and medium high-power performance has been implemented in Global Foundries 130-nm CMOS technology. To overcome the low breakdown voltage limit of the transistors, the triple-cascode based stacked configuration is utilized and the dual feedback based network is employed to achieve wideband matching performance. In addition, an active feedback linearizer is implemented in one of the feedback network to achieve gain expansion at high input power level, which results in improved output 1 dB gain compression power. With a power supply voltage of 3.3 V, the proposed PA achieves a saturated output power of 18 dBm and a maximum power-added efficiency (PAE) greater than 30% at the 10 GHz frequency.

articleTitle: Privacy-preserving Breast Cancer Prediction via Inner-Product Functional Encryption
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Machine learning is increasingly being used in the medical domain in recent years. However, due to increasing privacy concerns and requirements imposed by privacy-related regulations, the deployment of machine learning solutions in the medical field poses a significant challenge. As a new type of advanced encryption primitive, functional encryption allows fine-grained access control and selective computation on ciphertext, making it very suitable for privacy protection machine learning scenarios. In this paper, we propose a privacy-preserving breast cancer predication system based on a provable secure inner-product functional encryption scheme. The medical server trains the logistic regression model based on breast cancer data, and then a client encrypts his test data using the inner-product functional encryption scheme, and sends the encrypted test data to the medical server for predication, and the medical server complete the prediction by running the decryption algorithm of the inner-product functional encryption scheme, and sends the predication result to the client. Experimental results show that the proposed system has a significant effect on breast cancer data privacy protection, and achieves a high accuracy, which are close to the accuracy of the non-privacy protection logistic regression model on breast cancer data.

articleTitle: 5G based Cloud-Edge Collaboration for Canteen Self-Service Settlement Solution
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Canteen self-service settlement has attracted great interest for intelligent device manufacturers. Existing canteen self-service settlement technology are mainly two kinds: based on RFID technology and based on artificial intelligence image recognition technology. Although the self-service settlement technology based on RFID has the advantages of fast speed and high accuracy, the deployment cost is high, and special plates with RFID chips are needed, which limits the development and promotion of the technology. Compared to RFID, the cost of canteen self-service settlement technology based on deep learning image recognition is low. However, it costs large effort of testing and training in different canteen environments, which improves the difficulty of deployment. With the development of 5G technology, we propose a solution of canteen self-service settlement based on cloud-edge collaboration, which solves the problems of difficult deployment of canteen self-service settlement technology based on deep learning image recognition in different canteens and high cost of model training. The solution also widens the application of 5G technology, and contributes to the promotion of canteen self-service settlement technology.

articleTitle: Visual Detection Based Security and Control System in Power Construction
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Intelligent monitoring of the safety status of construction sites is of great significance. Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional methods such as poor real-time performance, low efficiency and no global control, a visual detection based security and control system in power construction is proposed. Taking advantage of its recognition of small objects, the YOLOv3 network is used as the main network. And the network structure and loss parameters are optimized according to characteristics of detected objects, so as to recognize multiple violations at the same time. Experiment results show that the algorithm achieves a processing speed of 18.26 fps and the recognition accuracy rate is 93.2%. So it can accurately recognize a variety of abnormal behaviors in real time.

articleTitle: Influence of Atmospheric Turbulence on States of Vortex Beams Carrying Orbital Angular Momentum
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the free-space optical communication, we research the propagation characteristics of the multiplexed vortex beams and the optical power contained in each OAM mode. We obtain the function which can provide a quantitative prediction for how the optical power of each OAM mode varies in atmospheric turbulence. We find that the optical power of OAM modes with initial topological charges will disperse to other OAM modes. And in strong atmospheric turbulence, all of the information content of the transmitted field is lost.

articleTitle: 8-12GHz Pre-matched Load Modulation Balanced Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A pre-matched load modulated balanced amplifier (LMBA) operating at 8-12GHz is presented. In the scenario of signal transmission with a large peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR), the efficiency performance of a power amplifier (PA) will degrade sharply at the power back-off (PBO) region. Hence, the active load modulation is used to improve the efficiency at 6-dB PBO. A prototype of LMBA MMIC was designed and simulated in the 0.25μm GaN HEMT process. The results demonstrate a peak output power of 43.1dBm over 8-12GHz, with drain efficiency (DE) of 52%-57%. Moreover, the DE is 41%- 44% at 6-dB PBO, achieving 12%-16% DE enhancement over an idealistic Class-B PA.

articleTitle: Stance Detection Using Multi-Head Attention Based Bidirectional GRU
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In social media, the purpose of stance detection is to analyze and judge the stance held on specific topics contained in the text, that is, support, opposition, and neutrality. This kind of data mining for social network stance tendencies has gradually become an important research direction. Stance detection is regarded as a sub branch of sentiment analysis, and in previous study, the comments stance are identified by machine learning models successfully. These models extract some semantic features, emotion features and so on. In the study, we extract the most significant features and build a feature-rich Support Vector Machine (SVM) that outperforms these models. We introduce a multi-head attention-based bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit Network (MHA-BiGRU) to detect stance comments in a given corpus. The experimental results show that the model we proposed surpass the general model of the baseline models and get expected results.

articleTitle: Digital Pre-charging Algorithm for High Accuracy Low Power DTC using Jump Search Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In consistent with the paradigm shift from high performance analog circuits to mixed analog-digital solution, this paper introduces a digital pre-charging algorithm to reduce the operating time of digital-to-analog converter (DAC) in digital-to-time converter (DTC), which has a huge impact on the power consumption and the resolution of DTC. The layout results based on standard 180nm technology prove that the dynamic power of DAC is reduced from 2mW to 1mW, and the resolution of DTC is improved from 800fs to 400fs. The digital circuit performing this algorithm only consumes 61.7uW of power and occupies 0.007mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of silicon area. In addition, the differential non-linearity (DNL) of DTC is 0.2 LSB.

articleTitle: ASTER Thermal Infrared Quantitative Inversion Research on the SiO2 Content of Surface Rocks in the Easten Tianshan Area of Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content information in rocks plays a very important role in the classification of igneous rock types and geological prospecting. The thermal infrared emissivity spectrum characteristics of silicate minerals can reflect their SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content well. This paper selects the rock spectrum data in the USGS and JHU spectrum library as the modeling sample, resamples the spectrum information to the ASTER thermal infrared band, and calculates the correlation coefficient between original spectrum, ratio spectrum and logarithmic spectrum of ASTER thermal infrared band and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content. On this basis, a number of multiple linear regression models based on ASTER thermal infrared spectroscopy and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content were established, and the accuracy of each model was evaluated. Finally, the model with the highest accuracy was selected to perform a quantitative inversion of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content on a scene of ASTER data in the Easten Tianshan area of Xinjiang. Through comparative research, the inversion results are in good agreement with the SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content of various lithologies in the geological map. It shows that this method is feasible for inversion of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> content regionally in surface rocks, and has certain guiding significance for remote sensing ore prospecting.

articleTitle: Research on Online Diagnosis Model of Metering Point Anomaly Based on High Precision and High Resolution High Frequency Acquisition Station Area Master Meter
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The power metering devices in residential areas often have errors and omissions, so it is necessary to set the abnormal diagnosis model of metering points. It is difficult to accurately read the abnormal data in the conventional metering point abnormal diagnosis model, which results in the low accuracy of the model in the process of abnormal diagnosis. Therefore, based on the high-precision high-resolution high-frequency acquisition station area master table, the metering point abnormal online diagnosis model is studied. Calculate the power consumption of the meter, set the judgment index of the abnormal state of the metering point, extract the abnormal data of the metering point of the master meter with high precision and high resolution through the classification of the abnormal characteristics of the metering point, set the automatic question answering model, and build the online diagnosis model of the abnormal metering point. The experimental results show that the average F-measure value of the three data sets in 1-10 cluster nodes is about 93.7% - 82.7%. Compared with the conventional three models, the maximum value of F-measure is about 2.7%, 8%, 2% higher, and the minimum value of F-measure is about 3.4%, 2.7%, 10.7% higher. Thus, compared with the conventional diagnosis model, this model can enhance the ability of abnormal diagnosis of metering points to a certain extent, and can judge the state of metering points more accurately.

articleTitle: Opportunistic Admissibility and Resource Allocation For Slicing-based Radio Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Network slicing (NS) is envisioned as a promising technology to meet the extremely diversified service requirements of users for future mobile networks. In radio access networks (RAN) slicing, the service providers (SPs) can rent network slicing instances from the infrastructure provider (InP) to meet the requirements of network services. However, both SPs and InP face the challenges of maintaining the quality of user experience and high profit in a dynamic environment, arising from random arrivals and departures of slice requests, uncertain resource availability, and multi-dimensional resource allocation. Therefore, admissibility and resource allocation become more complicated than that in traditional mobile networks. This paper proposes an opportunistic admissibility and resource allocation (OAR) policy to deal with the above challenges. To cope with the randomness of slice requests and resource availability, we first formulate this issue as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) problem to obtain the optimal admissibility strategy while maximizing the overall reward. Furthermore, we adopt a buyer-seller game-theoretic approach to optimize resource allocation, motivating SPs and InP to maximize their rewards. Numerical results show that the proposed OAR policy makes reasonable decisions effectively and steadily and outperforms the baseline scheme for system reward.

articleTitle: Malware Detection Using an Improved Active Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Machine learning techniques have been applied in malware detection widely. Variants or zero-day malwares might escape the detection of passive learning models. The annotation would be time-consuming and laborious if we maintain a passive learning model through updating its training data manually. To make the maintenance become automated and less-annotation-required, this paper proposes an active learning approach for malware detection. As the core of active learning, a selector is designed to select incremental training samples from open environment. It uses multiple criterions, including age, uncertainty, informativity and diversity of Portable Executable (PE) files, for selecting critical samples. We also evaluated the all-round static features of PE files for malicious detection and adopted 973-dim features according to their importance. Experimental results shows that the proposed active learning approach requires very less annotated training samples than passive learning methods, achieving high accuracy and efficiency. Existing sampling strategies using single criterion were also compared experimentally and performed inferior to this method.

articleTitle: Pilot Assignment Based on Graph Coloring with Sum-Rate Maximization in Cell-Free Massive MIMO
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To mitigate the severe effect of pilot contamination, a novel graph coloring (NGC) based algorithm is applied to pilot assignment in cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. Specifically, firstly, the potential pilot contamination intensity among users is calculated by utilizing the large-scale fading between users and access points (APs). Then, the contamination threshold is set to perform the sparsification and an interference graph describing the user interference relationship is constructed. Finally, the proposed algorithm is used to implement pilot assignment in the interference graph. In addition, an iterative grid search (IGS) approach is adopted to update the threshold to ensure that the system downlink sum-rate is maximized. The numerical results reveal that the proposed NGC pilot assignment algorithm with optimized thresholds can remarkably improve the system performance compared with previous pilot assignment schemes.

articleTitle: Co-Evolutionary of Public Goods Games Based on Learning Topology
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Network evolution is closely related to nodes revenue, which is determined by the strategies and topology of all participants in the group, topological structure and strategy interact with each other in the process of game. We want to know how the topology structure of nodes will affect the strategy evolution after adjusting it according to certain rules. According to this, we propose an edge-breaking and re-connection mechanism based on the learning node topology. In the learning process, the nodes can not only learn the strategies of the neighbor nodes, but also learn the topology structure of the neighbor nodes through the excess average degree. Each node relies on its own expectation degree to keep in line with the excess average degree of the learned node. Through Monte Carlo simulation experiments, we found that the cooperation starts when the gain factor is small, and soon the cooperation level can be high when the gain factor is increasing. This indicates this edge-breaking and re-connection mechanism based on learning other node’s topology can effectively promote the generation and maintenance of cooperation.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Image Scene Classification Based on Multi-level Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Remote sensing image scene classification is an important task in the fields of remote sensing image analysis and interpretation. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) has been a representative image classification network owing to its capacity of feature learning and representation. Although the semantic information of feature map was enhanced along with the convolution layer increases, the spatial geometric detail information may be lost, which will greatly affect the accuracy of classification. To solve these problem, we proposed a multi-level convolutional feature fusion network (MLCF<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>N) for remote sensing image scene classification. Specifically, the original image is fed to the multi-level feature extraction network to extract features of different levels by increasing the depth of the convolution layer. And then, in order to highlight the key interest areas of all levels, we design a key information weight network to obtain feature map of the discriminative area in each level feature. Finally, we fuse the low-level features, middle- level features and high- level features to get more discriminative features for scene classification. Experiments are conducted on several public remote sensing image scene classification datasets: AID, NWPU-RESISC45 and OPTIMAL 31 to evaluate the performance of the method in this paper. The experimental results show that multi- level feature fusion classification is better than single- level feature classification and some of the state of art methods.

articleTitle: A new dropout leaky control strategy for multi-channel narrowband active noise cancellation in irregular reverberation room
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Noise cancellation in a reverberation room is vital to hearing health. Although lots of methods in active noise control have been developed to solve this problem, as a matter of fact, because of the existence of irregular room distribution and related interference of adaptive filters, the noise reduction level and robustness need to be improved. In this work, a dropout leaky control strategy is proposed to improve the attenuation level and keep low less output of secondary loudspeakers in an irregular reverberation room. More exactly, the leaky filtered-x least mean square (LFxLMS) method is applied to decrease the related interference of adaptive filters. Then, each hidden leakage factor of LFxLMS is estimated by Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence. Furthermore, importance factor is introduced to keep several different noise cancellation areas. The results of 2D dimensional simulations confirm the proposed algorithm has better Global noise reduction.

articleTitle: HEVC Chroma Component Prediction Algorithm Based on Luminance Template Matching
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: DC mode and Planar mode are suitable to predict flat area and angle modes can well predict blocks with a single direction texture. However, above modes can not predict complex blocks effectively, whereas the correlation between the chroma and the luminance is quite high. To address this issue, this paper firstly proposes a chroma component prediction algorithm based on luminance template matching, and then improves the original HEVC chroma DM mode. Since chroma blocks of different size have different texture characteristics, different fusion algorithms are used for different template matching algorithm. The improved DM mode of the current chroma block uses the neighbouring chroma modes and the corresponding luminance block is taken into account. Therefore, the correlation between chroma and luminance is sufficiently utilized. To further improve the coding performance, convolutional filtering is used for chroma blocks with size under 32×32. The experimental results indicate that the algorithm proposed in this paper shows superior performance compared with HEVC standard, with bit rate saving 1.49% and 1.68% on average for Cb and Cr component respectively. And the average utilization of proposed mode is higher than that of some other original chroma intra prediction modes, which proves the effectiveness of our algorithm again.

articleTitle: Feature Aggregation and Topology Embedding on Convolution Neural Network for Airway Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Automatic airway segmentation is essential for quantitative measurement of lung diseases. However, most researches mainly suffer from two challenges: the spatial distribution and various branch pattern of airway, topology preserving of the segmentation. We propose a feature aggregation and topology embedding network (FATENet), which can combinate topology information and attention mechanism to mitigate those problems. Topology features are embedded into our network as a loss function, and attention mechanism are utilized to capture global dependencies. Topology features are embedded into our network as a loss function, and attention mechanism are utilized to capture global dependencies. This allows the network to generate more informative output and improve the segmentation performance. Our method is evaluated on 25 cases from different data resources. As compared to some existing method and network, we achieve the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), false positive rate (FPR), and true positive rate (TPR) are 93.4%, 0.054%, and 92.5%, respectively. The result shows that our method have accurate and efficient performance.

articleTitle: Resource Optimization Algorithm for Task Offloading of Service Robots with Position Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the wide application of service robots, task offloading of robots becomes a new research direction. Current studies do not fully consider the scenario of high robot density in some local areas, and the traditional schemes may lead to unreasonable allocation of offloading resources caused by robot congestion. In this paper, we propose an intelligent task offloading algorithm for service robots based on position prediction in the case of congestion. The overall idea is to predict the positions of pedestrians and robots by combining the social force model and the artificial potential field method. The predicted positions are used to indicate in advance the areas where pedestrians and robots may gather, and Q-learning is used to generate task offloading strategy for each robot. The algorithm can allocate the offloading resources in advance for the hot areas where pedestrians and robots gather, so as to avoid the problem that the service robots in this region cannot offload tasks when nearby base stations are fully occupied. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can solve task offloading in hot crowded areas well, and its delay is better than the other compared algorithms.

articleTitle: Joint Extraction of Entities and Relations by Adversarial Training and Mixup Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Joint extraction of entities and relations is an important task for building a knowledge graph and information extraction. However, small interference in the text can greatly change the semantics of words and sentences in natural language, thereby affecting the model’s prediction results. To solve the sensitivity of text to noise, in this paper, we present a method, called BERT of Adversarial Training and Sentence Mixup Data Augmentation (BERT-AT-SMDA), which use the BERT pre-training model to obtain the embedding vector representation of the text and then to incorporate the FGM adversarial training strategy into the fine-tuning of Bert to construct adversarial samples. Both the adversarial sample and the original sample into the encoder to training. Then, to prevent the over-fitting phenomenon and the additional interference caused by the instability of adversarial training, we introduce the mixup data augmentation method after obtaining the hidden layer of the encoder output, which performs a linear interpolation between the output hidden layer. In addition, we also study the effect of linear interpolation at different positions on the model’s joint extraction of entities and relations. We conduct experiments on a public dataset produced by the distant supervision method. The experimental results show that our method is effective for the joint extraction method based on tagging scheme. Not only improves the accuracy of entity and relation extraction, and ensures the robustness and generalization of the model.

articleTitle: A Novel Parallel Blind Equalizer for Underwater Acoustic Based on Dual Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Because of the complexity and time variability of underwater acoustic channel, the convergence speed and robustness of equalizer is significant for underwater acoustic communication system.
