In order to improve the performance of equalizer, a novel parallel blind equalizer based on constant modulus algorithm (CMA) and decision directed (DD) algorithm is proposed. According to the errors of the two algorithms, the parallel equalizer adjusts their proportion factor and iteration step size adaptively. In addition, a restart mechanism is established to improve the channel tracking ability of the equalizer. The experimental simulation results show that the proposed parallel equalizer can converge stably for different channels, with faster convergence speed and smaller steady-state residual error than both of the CMA and the DD equalizers, and can track the channel changes quickly.

articleTitle: A Dynamic and Secure Migration Method of Cryptographic Service Virtual Machine for Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve the continuity of cryptographic services and ensure the quality of services in the cloud environment, a dynamic migration framework of cryptographic service virtual machines based on the network shared storage system is proposed. Based on the study of the security threats in the migration process, a dynamic migration attack model is established, and the security requirement of dynamic migration is analyzed. It designs and implements the dynamic security migration management software, which includes a dynamic migration security enhancement module based on the Libvirt API, role-based access control policy, and transmission channel protection module. A cryptographic service virtual machine migration environment is built, and the designed management software and security mechanism are verified and tested. The experimental results show that the method proposed in the paper can effectively improve the security of cryptographic service virtual machine migration.

articleTitle: Digital Twin-driven Multi-objective Optimization Production Scheduling with Restraint Tool Resources
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, digital twin has become a key technology for intelligent transformation of manufacturing industry, providing a new paradigm of smart manufacturing. The scheduling planning of traditional workshops is mostly based on unlimited resource conditions because the remaining useful lifetime of manufacturing resources such as cutting tools cannot be obtained in real time. In this paper, a digital twin-driven production scheduling framework is proposed that integrated the problems of equipment predictive maintenance and production scheduling. Under this framework, an improved NSGA-II algorithm is proposed to combine cutting tool predictive maintenance and production scheduling tasks, and experimental results show that the algorithm has better performance.

articleTitle: Outlier Detection and Abnormal Subspace Search Based on Autoencoder and Genetic Algorithm for High-Dimensional Data
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The curse of dimensionality in high-dimensional data makes it difficult to detect outliers in full data space. In this paper, we propose an outlier detection and abnormal subspace search method based on autoencoder and genetic algorithm for high-dimensional data to alleviate this problem. This work uses neural networks to build an autoencoder that forces the high-dimensional data to be mapped into a low-dimensional space. The compressed data is decoded and reconstructed, and the error between the original data and the reconstructed data is compared with a threshold value to achieve unsupervised outlier detection. Then our method searches the subspaces of high-dimensional outliers by genetic algorithm. It encodes subspaces of the outliers and uses the redefined fitness function to evaluate the degree of outlier of the detected subspace. The subspace with the highest degree of outlier is output as the abnormal subspace of the detected point. The abnormal subspace features can be used as a basis for analyzing the causes of outliers. Experimental results reveal that the proposed method, when compared with other competitive methods, can effectively detect outliers in high-dimensional data and obtain the accurate abnormal subspace of outliers.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Docking Process and Collision Problems of AUV Based on Joint Control Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, the collision problem between the underwater robot and the bell-mouth guided docking station in the process of dynamic docking is studied by using ADAMS/MATLAB co-simulation technology. By analyzing AUV’s underwater force condition and collision related parameters, the collision force curve during the dynamic docking process of AUV and recovery docking station under the given initial state was solved, and the maximum collision force during the collision process was obtained. It provides a reference for the minimum collision force that the system and materials can bear in the actual docking process. At the same time, a collision attitude control system with PID as the main control method is designed to realize the recovery task of AUV under the environmental interference. The control system can not only adjust the attitude of the AUV after the collision with the mobile docking station, but also reduce the dynamic docking time of the AUV and improve the recovery efficiency. It has great practical significance and can provide guidance for the dynamic docking task of the actual AUV.

articleTitle: Speech Enhancement Based on Time Domain Parallel Full Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a speech enhancement method based on parallel time-domain full convolution network (FCN) is proposed. In this method, by optimizing the parameters of each branch, each branch can extract signal features with different granularity, so that the whole network can learn more complete implicit features of speech signals and improve the effect of speech enhancement; The designed network structure does not contain full connection layer, which greatly reduces the amount of training parameters. Different from the neural network enhancement method based on amplitude spectrum, the time domain method does not need to obtain the transformation domain features such as spectrogram, which reduces the complexity of the algorithm. At the same time, the network is trained directly with time-domain speech signal to retain the original phase information of speech, which can effectively reduce the impact of phase information loss on speech synthesis. Simulation results show that the parallel time-domain full convolution network speech enhancement algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively improve speech quality.

articleTitle: Research on Location Mechanism of Electric Internet of Things based on IPv6
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the advance of power Internet of Things construction, the number of power equipment connected to the network has increased sharply. As an important function of power equipment, positioning service provides strong support for normal operation of transmission, substation, distribution and other scenarios. Existing positioning technologies are becoming increasingly mature, but with the access of a large number of devices, the positioning business of devices will be huge, which will bring huge energy consumption costs and resource occupancy. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a wireless positioning system model based on IPv6, which encodes and binds the IPv6 address and positioning information of the device communication, and finally puts forward the optimization mechanism of the positioning communication network of the electric Internet of Things. Experimental results show that the proposed positioning scheme and the optimization mechanism of positioning information transmission can effectively improve the accuracy of positioning and reduce the time delay, packet loss rate and energy consumption in the communication process.

articleTitle: Fault Detection of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on SVD-RF
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the traditional motor fault detection model, the algorithm has a single selection of classification features, weak generalization ability, and is prone to overfitting, under-learning and other shortcomings. This paper proposes a motor fault detection model combines the random forest and the improved singular value decomposition method: based on the characteristic frequency feature data of the motor fault, the singular value decomposition method is used to extract the maximum change axis and the smaller change axis. The optimal feature subspace affecting the performance of random forest classification detection is obtained by extracting features from these two parts through a stratified sampling method, and then selecting features and split points in this feature subspace to generate a decision tree to construct a random forest fault detection model. Finally, the fault detection model is used to predict the state of the motor. The experimental test shows that the fault detection method is more responsive and accurate than other commonly used fault detection models.

articleTitle: An Uplink Node Pairing Algorithm for Non- orthogonal Multiple Access Backscatter Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To further improve energy supplement and spectrum efficiency in non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) assisted backscattering communication, in this paper, a novel node pairing algorithm, dual-node pairing (DNP-BG) algorithm, is proposed. Specifically, based on the distance between the backscatter nodes (BNs) and the reader, the coverage area is divided into two sub-areas. To achieve double-node pairing, we analyze this scenery with the weighted bipartite graph and try to find the maximum weight matching of it. Subsequently, we take maximum weight sum of the weighted bipartite graph to achieve the backscatter node pairing. Simulation shows that the number of successfully decoded bits with our proposed scheme outperforms that of other pairing algorithms, in both the thresholds of signal to interference noise ratio (SINR) and transmit power.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Allocation for D2D underlaying Cellular Networks: An MDP based Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Device to device (D2D) communication supports direct communications between nearby devices which is a potential technology in the fifth generation wireless mobile communication system. To maximize the total rate of D2D pairs when the system has constraints on the powers, we investigate the optimal power allocation strategy for D2D communications. We first transform the power allocation problem into a sequential decision problem and model the power allocation problem as a Markov Decision Process (MDP). Then, we derive the closed-form expression of the optimal powers for the D2D pairs and theoretically prove its optimality. Simulation results have demonstrated that the proposed power allocation algorithm achieves the highest total rate of D2D pairs among the compared algorithms. Moreover, the power allocation strategy can achieve high total rate of D2D pairs when varying different parameters of the system.

articleTitle: Neighbor Discovery with Capture Effect Based on Directional Transmission in Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper studies the capture effect on the neighbor discovery in directional Ad Hoc network. If the nodes in adopt the random neighbor discovery algorithm, the problem of packet conflict occurring in the process of neighbor discovery is solved by the capture effect, which makes the problem no longer invalid transmission and effectively improves the throughput and stability of the network. Through the comparison of the simulation results, it is concluded that under the capture effect, the total time slots needed by the nodes to complete the neighbor discovery process has been significantly increased. In addition, on the premise that the nodes have the capture effect, aiming at the influence of node transmission probability on the convergence rate of algorithm. The simulation experiments of three transmission probabilities are carried out. By comparing the total number of time slots consumed by nodes to complete the neighbor discovery process, it is concluded that the algorithm has a better performance when the transmission probability P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf> =0.5.

articleTitle: Key-Point Based Distribution Probability Optimization for Object Detection in Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, object detection in remote sensing images has been an important topic in computer vision. As a mainstream approach to detectors, single-stage detectors usually compute the important points of the bounding box to get the location of the target, and optimize them by Focal Loss. One of the development trends for one-stage detectors is to combine with Localization Quality Estimation (LQE), which can provide accurate ranking scores, and thus bring benefits to the Non-Maximum Suppression as well as the following detection results. In this paper, we propose a one-stage detector, named Key-point based Distribution Probability Optimization (KDPO), for remote sensing object detection. Specially, we first classify and locate the object through five key points. Then, we merge the quality estimation into the class prediction vector to form a joint representation of localization quality and classification. Next, we utilize a vector to represent arbitrary distribution of box locations. The improved representations avoid the inconsistency risk and accurately describe the flexible distribution of the data. Meanwhile, we use the improved Focal Loss for the succeed optimization. The proposed method is tested on two popular aerial image datasets, including HRSC2016 and DOTA. In all experiments, our approach achieves promising performance comparing to the state-of-the-art detectors.

articleTitle: Design of a Routing Protocol with Minimum End-to-End Delay in MR-MC Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper studies how to find a path with the least link delay in a multi-radio multi-channel (MR-MC) network. Different from a single-radio single-channel (SR-SC) network, the design of a routing protocol in MR-MC network needs to take into account the impact of intra-flow interference and inter-flow interference. In addition, load balancing also plays a very important role in improving wireless network performance. In this article, we focus on the minimum link delay and propose a new routing metric called Link Channel Diversity End-to-end Delay (LCDEED), which takes into account not only the transmission delay but also the queuing delay. Then we also propose a novel routing scheme by modifying Optimized Link State Routing (OLSR) protocol to apply our proposed metric. The simulation results show that the routing metric we proposed has improved the performance of the MR-MC network.

articleTitle: Modulation Recognition Based on Lightweight Residual Network via Binary Quantization
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Signal modulation recognition is an important and complicated problem in spectrum monitoring. In recent years, many advanced deep learning methods have been proposed for this problem. However, the high computational cost of deep neural networks largely hinders practical deployment. In this paper, we consider the signal modulation recognition problem via the deep residual network and propose a binary quantization scheme to reduce the model size and memory cost. This is achieved by simultaneously increasing shortcuts and maintaining full-precision weights and outputs of key layers in binary residual network in a simple way. The results show that with competitive accuracy, 95% of multiply–accumulate operations of model are converted into binary operations under 0 dB snr. In summary, the proposed method can effectively reduce the parameters and complexity of recognition model.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Based on Bi-Dual Inference
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, machine learning has achieved rapid development in solving artificial intelligence tasks in many fields such as translation and image. Dual learning as a new learning paradigm, the core idea is to use primitive tasks (mapping from domain X to domain Y ) and dual tasks (from domain Y to domain X). Mapping to improve the performance of the two tasks. Such as translation from one language to another and reverse translation, emotion recognition and sentence generation, etc. The importance of this duality is shown by these studies that it can promote the learning of two tasks in the dual form. The dual inference is proposed on the basis of dual learning to study how to use structural duality in the reasoning stage of artificial intelligence tasks to improve the performance of the model. In this article, we propose a general Bi-dual inference framework, through the use of different initialization and data access order random seed independent training to obtain different agent models ( f, g ), so that multiple f or g Perform reasoning on a single task. We apply it to five-element sentiment classification, finally, the effectiveness of the model is verified on the data sets NLPCC2014 and NLPCC2018, and good results are obtained.

articleTitle: Deep Motion Vector Prediction for Versatile Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Versatile video coding (VVC) has made significant progress in the compression efficiency of video coding. It achieves better performance and halves bitrate compared to the high efficiency video coding (HEVC) under the same visual quality. However, the complexity of VVC has also been significantly increased, especially in inter prediction. This paper proposes an improved motion vector prediction method based on neural networks for motion estimation (ME). Firstly, dynamic weights are proposed in the process of selecting the best MVP for advanced motion vector prediction (AMVP); secondly, we build the motion vector prediction model based on the deep neural network; finally, the model is embedded in VVC to acquire a more accurate MVP and reduce the encoding complexity of ME. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can reduce the encoding time of motion estimation under the premise of guaranteeing video quality.

articleTitle: MOTUNER: An Online Automatic Container Tuning System for Spark on YARN
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nowadays Spark has become one of the most popular big data frameworks. In the deploy mode of Spark on YARN, applications apply for resources in the form of "container". The size of the container is set by parameter and will affect the running efficiency, but due to various application characteristics and different cluster scale it’s difficult for users to set the parameter properly. To solve this problem, in this paper we present MOTUNER, an online auto-tune system for Spark on YARN, which dynamically adjusts the container size while the application is running. It consists of two parts: monitor and tuner. The monitor collects metrics of allocated containers and the tuner dynamically tunes the size of newly coming containers according to a search algorithm. By adjusting memory of containers to an optimal value adaptively, it provides an automatic, low-overhead and efficient way of container parameter tuning. The performance of MOTUNER was evaluated by HiBench benchmark, and results showed that it effectively reduces application’s cost by up to 31% and improves memory utilization, alleviating over or under utilization.

articleTitle: A Variable Step-size Mixed Modulated Lagrange Explicit Time Delay Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Time delay estimation of passive sonar plays a crucial role in target range and target azimuth. The accurate time delay estimation algorithm with non-integer sampling period, which is also called fractional time delay, has attracted much attention. To estimate the fractional time delay of bandlimited signals, the mixed modulated Lagrange explicit time delay estimator is put forward, and it acts well. It is a fixed step-size algorithm, which means it cannot procure fast convergence rate and simultaneously give out small steady-state error. In this paper, a variable step-size algorithm based on the iteration time is proposed for mixed modulated Lagrange explicit time delay estimator. Simulation results demonstrate that, for bandlimited BPSK signals, the proposed algorithm can yield faster convergence speed at early stage and smaller time delay estimation variance in its steady state than the fixed step-size one.

articleTitle: A Modified Key Generation Scheme of Vigenère Cipher Algorithm using Pseudo-Random Number and Alphabet Extension
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, many modifications have been done to combat the weaknesses of the Vigenère Cipher Algorithm. Several studies have been carried out to rectify the flaw of the algorithm’s repeating key nature by increasing the key length equal to that of the plain text. However, some characters cannot be encrypted due to the limited set of characters in the key. This paper modified the algorithm’s key generation process using a Pseudo-Random Number Generator to improve the algorithm’s security and expanded the table of characters to up to 190 characters. The results show that based on Monobit examination and frequency analysis, the repeating nature of the key is non-existent, and the generated key can be used to encrypt a larger set of characters. The ciphertext has a low IC value of 0.030, which is similar to a random string and polyalphabetic cipher with an IC value of 0.038 but not equal to a monoalphabetic cipher with an IC value of 0.065. Results show that the modified version of the algorithm performs better than some of the recent studies conducted on it

articleTitle: Face Recognition System with Feature Fusion for Rehabilitation Robots in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Face recognition is a research problem across multiple disciplines such as computer vision, pattern recognition, artificial intelligence, psychology, healthcare etc. At present, the rehabilitation centers in hospitals are dependent on the nursing staff with no implementation of rehabilitation automation. In this study of face detection, a facial expression recognition system was developed which can be useful for robots of rehabilitation nursing beds. This article mainly researches two aspects: face image feature extraction and classifier design. Since many low-resolution face images are often encountered in actual environments (such as surveillance), if you use traditional methods to directly extract image features, the results are often not satisfactory. For the influence of face recognition results, this paper proposes a feature fusion extraction method based on KNN with LDA(Fisherfaces) and PCA (eigenfaces). First, the original image (low resolution) is decomposed into three different resolution images, and then the three images are used as the basis for the position to extract facial features, then LDA and PCA are used to perform preliminary analysis to obtain reduced dimensional reduction features. Finally use the K-nearest neighbor classifier to perform classification prediction. Study compares KNN-LDA with KNN-PCA with different distances of KNN algorithm.

articleTitle: Implementation of Adaptive Airborne SAR Motion Compensation Algorithm based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional synthetic aperture radar (SAR) motion compensation algorithm implemented by digital signal processor (DSP) or soft core, such as high cost, slow calculation speed and poor stability, an adaptive motion compensation algorithm based on field programmable gate array (FPGA) is proposed in this paper. CORDIC algorithm, Gauss-Kruger projection calculation, coordinate rotation calculation and arctangent calculation are realized through Verilog, and tested on JFM7k325t FPGA of Fudan Microelectronics Company. The test results show that the calculation speed of the algorithm is significantly improved under the requirement of system accuracy. Because the system transforms the absolute position of the target and the aircraft into the Gaussian plane rectangular coordinate system for calculation, and only uses FPGA to realize the algorithm, the radar volume and the power consumption are reduced, the measurement accuracy, measurement area range and flexibility are higher, and the adaptability is stronger.

articleTitle: Optimized Sub-Rate Sampling in 80Gbaud DP-64QAM Coherent Optical Receivers
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The sampling rate of Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs) is a key technology for high speed optical links. It is difficult for DSP to recover the clock and data due to the impact of ADCs’ sub-sampling. For DP-64QAM coherent optical communication system, anti-aliasing and optimal sampling are used to realize the sub-sampling of ADCs. The sampling rate and bit error rate can be reduced in the simulation experiment.

articleTitle: Optimized LRU Algorithm for STT-MRAM/SRAM Hybrid Cache Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The rapid development of Non-Volatile Memory (NVM) prompts advanced computer architecture. With byte addressing method, low static power consumption and non-volatility, spin-transfer torque magnetic random-access memory (STT-MRAM) is considered as one of the most promising alternatives to SRAM for cache application. However, STT-MRAM has three times the read latency compared to SRAM. In addition, the simple replacement scheme cannot tap into the advantages of NVM. In this article, we propose a hybrid cache architecture integrating both SRAM and STT-MRAM. In this hybrid cache architecture, STT-MRAM acts as the backup of SRAM. The system queries the counter and valid bits of the cache line through byte addressing, and forms a dynamic matrix of the cache lines that meet the conditions. The least-recently-used (LRU) algorithm confirms the starting node of the cache line in the dynamic matrix according to the capacity of the cache each time, and then searches for the cache line that needs the cache capacity according to the starting node to perform data replacement. The simulation results demonstrate that the system access time can be reduced by 1.2 times compared with previous LRU.

articleTitle: Enhanced Bidirectional Propagation Network for Video Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Video super-resolution (VSR) aims to restore a high-resolution (HR) frame from a given corresponding low-resolution (LR) frame. For most VSR models, the pipeline mainly includes feature extraction module, alignment module, fusion module and reconstruction module, among them, the alignment module and the fusion module are the most important. Based on BasicVSR, we propose an enhanced bidirectional propagation network which is both effective and efficient in exploiting previous and next frames to super-resolve the current frame. In the alignment module, in order to obtain a precisely offsets for alignment, we combine optical flow with deformable convolution (DCN). In the fusion module, we propose a channel and double attention module (CDAM) to extract the important features and suppress the unimportant features in channel dimension in addition, it can capture the long-range dependencies too. The experiments demonstrate the proposed method can effectively achieve superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Train Passengers Prediction for Railway Management System Using Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Passenger predicting is an integral component of advanced, automated, and innovative railway transit operations and management. In this paper, regression analysis was utilized using the Polynomial regression method to predict the passengers of Philippine railway transportation during the COVID-19 pandemic and in the succeeding years 2022, 2023, and 2024 for the main railway transits in the country namely: Light Rail Transit Line 1 (LRT-1), Light Rail Transit Line 2 (LRT-2), and Metro Rail Transit Line 3. Polynomial regression is used when the data has a non-linear relationship with each other and the independent variables have to be modified to some degree. During the pandemic in 2020, the train passengers were decreased by 68.38% (LRT1), 78.06% (LRT2), and 67.19% (MRT3). The predicted number of train passengers is starting to increase in 2022 from 22% to 30%. The model formulation with the utilization of regression analysis is an effective way for passenger volume prediction that can be used for railway management systems such as rail transport service evaluation, train passenger crowd regulation, and train scheduling system.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: MRSNet: A Spatial and Channel Attention Integration Network Considering Multi-Resolution Improves Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, convolution neural network (CNN) and attention mechanism are widely used in image denoising. A novel CNN feature extraction block is proposed in this paper, namely, MRSBlock, which processes multiple image resolutions and introduces sparse attention. Ablation experiments on MRSBlock show it improves the denoising effect. This paper presents MRSNet based on MRSBlock and channel attention mechanism to achieve an effective combination of sparse attention and channel attention in image denoising. Experiments results show that MRSNet gets competitive peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) results with fewer parameters and computation cost.

articleTitle: Multi-View Person Re-IDentification with Wireless Multimedia Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Wireless Multimedia Sensor Networks (WMSN) involves a set of multimedia sensors such as cameras to collect video or audio data about the deployed Region of Interest (RoI). Compared to traditional Wireless Sensor Networks, the visible information of covered targets can be obtained with WMSN. Moreover, due to dense deployment of low-cost cameras, the object such as person may be covered by several cameras. This paper introduces a new multi-view person Re-IDentification (Re-ID) model with WMSN. Moreover, human skeleton extraction based person Re-ID method is applied to extract person’s posture feature. As a result, significant cost by labeling data will be avoided. Finally, Decision-level and Feature-level feature fusion methods with multi-view cameras are proposed to complete Re-Identification process. Multi-view video-based than Re-ID algorithm has better performance than single-view video-based Re-ID algorithm. As we know, this is to first research on person Re-Identification with WMSN.

articleTitle: An Intelligent System for 50-Meter Running Test Based on Image Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problems involving heavy tasks, difficult organization, and error-prone in 50-meter running test, we use the GhostNet model and FaceNet algorithm to detect and recognize the human body and face with the real-time acquisition of 50-meter running test process image, completing identification and calculation of the score. It can accomplish the intelligentization of 50-meter running test. The algorithm introduces a depthwise separable convolution module, which improves the inference speed. Experiments show that the algorithm achieves 16.7 FPS on GPU devices. The gap with the average score which calculated by people is just 0.16 seconds, meeting the requirements of the test system for fast and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Two-Path Successive Relaying Based on Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access With Partial CSI
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-path successive relaying (TPSR) scheme based on power domain non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA), in which instantaneous channel state information (CSI) of source-to-relay and relay-to-destination channels are not required. Successive interference cancellation is applied at the relay to eliminate the inter-relay interference. Owing to differential binary phase-shift keying (DBPSK) modulation with non-coherent detection, only partial CSI, i.e., channel distribution information is required for source-to-relay and relay-to-destination channels. The closed-form end-to-end bit error rate (BER) is derived and validated by the simulation. The proposed NOMA-TPSR scheme can approach the BER performance of half-duplex relaying, and improve the spectral efficiency significantly. The BER performance and the spectral efficiency of NOMA-TPSR outperform that of direct transmission and full-duplex relaying with residual self-interference exceeding a certain level.

articleTitle: Design of High Performance SIW Filter in Millimeter Wave Band
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a sixth order folded filter and a sixth order "cul-de-sac" filter used for millimeter wave band are designed and fabricated on a single-layer PCB using coupling matrix synthesis and substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) technology. The measurement results show that the insertion loss at the center frequency of the first filter is 2.24 dB, the passband return loss is greater than 10 dB, the relative bandwidth of 3 dB is 10.4% (from 24.6 GHz to 27.3 GHz). The second filter has a center frequency insertion loss of 1.89 dB, a passband return loss of more than 10 dB, a 3dB relative bandwidth of 9.6% (from 24.8 GHz to 27.3 GHz). The selectivity is improved by reasonably introducing out-of-band transmission zeros. The 20 dB rectangular coefficients of the two filters are 1.55 and 1.49, respectively. Both filters have high performance and have a very wide application prospect in millimeter wave communication system.

articleTitle: An Energy Saving Routing Strategy with Differentiated Service Provide Ability for UAV Assisted Disaster Rescue
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The cooperation of multiple Unmanned Aerial vehicles (UAVs) plays a significant role in disaster rescue. This paper aims at improving the performance of UAV networks in the emergency communication scenario. Both the network lifetime and quality of service (QoS) are jointly designed by using the software defined network (SDN) structure. To this end, an energy saving routing strategy (ESRS) and a differentiated queue scheduling scheme (DQSS) are sequentially proposed for the controllers and assess points in the UAV networks. The remaining energy of the frequently used UAV is maximized and the queues of each UAVs are dynamic configured according to the different services priority. Simulation results show that ESRS extends the life of the whole network to nearly three times the original. Through the evaluation of various QoS parameters, DQSS is proven to effectively provide differentiated service.

articleTitle: Dupopt: A Redundancy Video Analysis Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The video analysis based on Deep Neural Network (DNN) model has been widely deployed to provide various services in mobile applications. DNN-based video analysis with high accuracy requires massive computation power beyond the hardware capability of mobile devices. Offloading to an edge server or remote cloud server is a promising solution to solve the above challenge. However, offloading computation leads to higher network latency which will reduce analysis accuracy. This paper uses redundant transmission to reduce network latency in video analysis and proposes a mechanism named Dupopt, which can select the optimal combination of copy number and frame resolution to maximize analysis accuracy. Numerical results show that the mechanism Dupopt can significantly improve the accuracy of video analysis compared with the transmission mechanism without redundancy.

articleTitle: A Symbol Rate Estimation Scheme for Non-Cooperative Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In non-cooperative communication, symbol rate estimation is a prerequisite for signal demodulation. However, it is particularly difficult to estimate the symbol rate in the scenario with unknown modulation type and root cosine roll-off shaping. In this paper, an estimator without the requirement of communication parameters is proposed. First, the signal is recognized as constant envelope or non-constant envelope signal by square spectrum. Then, for the former, the symbol rate estimation is based on wavelet transform; for the latter, an envelope velocity strategy is adopted. In the proposed scheme, we elaborate some design details, including resampling factor, extraction of discrete spectral lines in the squared spectrum, selection of wavelet transform scale, and compensation of frequency deviation. We further propose a low-complexity implementation to meet the requirements for real-time capability and accuracy. Simulation results show that our proposed scheme is effective and accurate.

articleTitle: Weak ties Discovery Based on Network Representation Learning and Structural Features
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As the scale of social networks continues to expand, the information contained in the network is growing explosively. How to effectively extract valuable information from the network has attracted the attention of many researchers. Link prediction is based on the current and historical structure of the network to predict new links that may be formed in the future. It can mine hidden information from the network and promote the development of the network structure. Many articles are looking for influential nodes, while ignoring the influence of edges. This paper proposes a new edge quantification method, and the experimental results on many large networks such as email YouTube DBLP prove its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Graphical System Design of Test Cases in Flight Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the flight control system test and verification platform, explore the graphical design of test cases in a distributed test environment. Aiming at the problems of complicated test case form in distributed test environment and inconvenience for operators to record and call, analyze according to the actual needs of flight control system testers, adopt formal description method, and describe the execution process with state machine. A set of maintainable and easy to expand graphical system of test cases is designed. Experiments show that the system realizes the visual management of flight control system test cases. Through the conversion of test cases from text to graphics, it can be organically combined with complex test requirements and environments, and the flight control system can be improved in a complex application environment. Test efficiency and test quality.

articleTitle: Secure Rate Maximization for Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface Assisted Transmission with Low-resolution DACs
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper investigates the secrecy rate of multiple reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs)-assisted millimeter wave system with low-resolution digital-to-analog converters, where a base station (BS) serves a single-antenna user while a single-antenna eavesdropper wiretapping the information sent to the user. To reduce energy consumption, the RIS that can provide maximal secrecy rate is selected to assist transmission. With the consideration of the quantization noise, we design the transmit beamforming at the BS and RIS phase shift jointly to maximize the achievable secure rate subject to transmit power constraint and unit-modulus constraint. However, it is a non-convex fractional programming problem. To tackle this non-convex problem, the alternative optimization algorithm is introduced to decouple the variables. Specifically, the quadratic transform technique is adopted to design the transmit beamforming, and the phase shift of RIS is obtained by generalized Rayleigh quotient algorithm. Numerical results demonstrate that considerable secrecy rate can be achieved without significant loss caused by quantization noise in the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Scalable CNN Accelerator with FPGA On-board Resource Optimization for Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a scalable hardware accelerating system deployed on FPGA that can efficiently accelerate various types of convolution for semantic segmentation networks is designed. A hierarchical multiple line buffer structure is proposed to flexibly construct convolution dataflow and utilize FPGA on-chip resources. The accelerating system is validated on both ZYNQ series high performance SoC and XC7A100T board with a RISC-V core. The results show that the proposed system can be easily implemented and migrated to different FPGA platforms with high computation efficiency.

articleTitle: An Unequal Error Protection Scheme of H.265 Video Stream in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Under the technological development nowadays, bit error remains hard to be solved in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) video transmission system. The common Equal Error Protection (EEP) scheme ignores the reality that the importance of different components of the video stream varies, leading to limitation of protection performance. This paper proposes an Unequal Error Protection (UEP) scheme of H.265 video stream based on Low Density Parity Check Code (LDPC). In this scheme, the video stream information is encoded and transmitted hierarchically according to its varying degrees of sensitivity to bit error. It can reduce the influence of the bit error, which is generated during transmission, on the video’s quality and improve the reliability of the UAV video transmission system without additional need of transmission bandwidth.

articleTitle: Inventory Control under Unobserved Losses with Latent State Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The unobserved losses have been a challenge to the applicability of automatic systems for inventory control. Due to the inability to record these events, systems cannot make the best decisions. In this sense, it is necessary to account for these losses to learn policies that allow inventory to be managed automatically. In this work, reinforcement learning has been successfully applied to an inventory management problem with unobserved losses. To do so, an inventory level inference model that considers unobserved losses was used. This solution does not depend on any distribution assumptions over sales and unobserved losses, but rather it estimates the distributions solely from observations and inputs of the system. During training, the model learns the transition and observation functions as distributions over inventory levels. The model simultaneously accounts state uncertainty and computes beliefs over inventory states. After the model is trained, it can be combined with a model-free reinforcement learning algorithm, such as Q-learning, to determine a policy for the inventory management. This policy can be used as automated system for the management of the inventory. The results suggests that this system can improve the inventory management performance by reducing the uncertainty of inventory levels without specifying the transition and observation distributions.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Design of Dynamical Tracking for Connected and Automated Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of UAV technology, the re-search of leader-follower formation tracking has been extensively studied due to its simple formation structure and communication connection. However, the high maneuverability and dynamics of UAVs make the formation tracking control much more complicated and difficult. In this paper, the optimal formation control algorithms are proposed for both near-equilibrium and general dynamic control cases considering the time-varying leader velocity and communication delays. In near-equilibrium control case, a linear optimal control strategy is proposed, and the function coefficient can be derived by using a backward recursion. Then, the result of the near-equilibrium case is extended to the general dynamic case where the leader moves at an uncertain time-varying velocity. In each sampling period, based on the updated state information of UAVs, the optimal formation control strategy can be obtained by the same algorithm design approach as the near-equilibrium case, and the function coefficient is the convergent value deduced by using a backward recursion manner.

articleTitle: Reform on Circuit and Electronic Technology Experiment Based on Virtual-real Combination
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the current situation of the experiment of circuit and electronic technology, this paper expounds the necessity of the experiment of virtual reality combination of circuit and electronic technology, puts forward the experimental teaching mode of "virtual reality combination", designs the experimental process of "virtual reality combination" with Kirchhoff's current law as an example, and finally studies the specific measures of the experimental mode of virtual reality combination. Practice shows that the experimental mode of combining virtual and real can be used to improve students' interest in circuit and electronic technology and improve the learning effect of experimental courses, which is a feasible experimental mode.

articleTitle: SiamPBN: Point-based Siamese Network for Rotating Objects Tracking
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, the Siamese network based trackers have achieved outperforming results in the metrics of speed and accuracy in terms of visual tracking. However, it is difficult for the Siamese networks to achieve the accurate location of rotating objects. This paper proposes an efficient network architecture named SiamPBN to resolve rotation problem in tracking. We find that the predicted center of the object deviates from the center of the predicted box while the object rotates continuously. Therefore, we add a centerness head to the network to improve the performance of handling rotating objects. In addition, SiamPBN obtains the predicted outputs by point-based instead of anchor-based method, thus avoiding the complex computation associated with anchors. Our proposed method has gained the excellent performance on the datasets, including GOT-10k, LaSOT and VOT2019.

articleTitle: Link Scheduling for Multiple-Directional Antennas in Ad hoc Network: A Quasi-order Theoretic Viewpoint
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Directional antennas can greatly improve communication performance in wireless ad hoc network (WANET) over traditional omnidirectional antennas. Multiple-Directional Antennas (MDAs) are a set of directional antennas supporting several directional transmitting and receiving. MDAs not only inherit the advantages of directional antennas, but also support parallel communication with multiple adjacent nodes. However, only through complex scheduling of wireless links can these advantages be realized. Currently, the study of link scheduling problems is mainly to construct link scheduling strategies according to the current network communication requirements. This makes the scheduling strategy highly coupled with the current communication scenario and lacks flexibility. This paper proposes a new method of constructing link scheduling strategy based on the theory of quasi-order relation. This method is suitable for constructing all feasible scheduling strategies in small WANET. Subsequently, the network scheduling equipment only needs to find the best matching strategy in the scheduling strategy set to better complete the complex scheduling control.

articleTitle: External Sparsity Combined with Internal Low-Rankness for Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nonlocal self-similarity (NSS) as a remarkable prior has been successfully applied to image processing including image denoising. For each local patch in an image, we can search for many nonlocally similar patches under NSS prior and stack them into a group, and then process the group instead of a patch to better capture the nonlocal structure. Most existing methods consider the NSS either of the internal degraded image or from an external clean corpus, which may limit the denoising performance. In this paper, we propose a hybrid model to catch both the external and internal NSS. Specifically, we develop a model with two regularizers, the internal NSS is exploited by a low-rankness regularizer, and the external NSS is exploited by a sparse regularizer. An alternating minimization method is developed to solve our model. Experimental results demonstrate that our algorithm achieves better results compared with several state-of-the-art denoising methods.

articleTitle: Routing and Spectrum Allocation in Dynamic Optical Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to the advantages of global coverage and large capacity, satellite optical networks (OSNs) have been widely used in military and commercial applications. However, time-varying topology and coarse-grained resource partitioning pose a challenge on routing and spectrum allocation. This paper proposes a resource space-time evolving graph (RSTEG) to achieve fine-grained resource representation. Based on RSTEG, the problem of routing and spectrum allocation in dynamic OSN can be transformed into the problem of maximizing the amount of transferred data under limited resources, which is an integer programming problem. For reducing complexity, a two-stage path determination and resource allocation (TPDRA) algorithm is proposed to solve the problem. Results demonstrate that TPDRA can significantly improve transferred data compared with other alternative algorithms.

articleTitle: A Simultaneous Denoise and Dereverberation by a Use of Two-Stage Joint Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Our auditory experience is constantly disturbed by background noise and indoor reverberation in the actual speech environment, seriously damaging speech intelligibility and quality. In the past studies, people have proposed a two-stage deep neural network based on frequency domain to eliminate the above interference, and they suffer from some limitations, resulting in the upper limit of its performance. This paper proposes an end-to-end two-stage deep neural network in the time domain, eliminating noise in the first stage and reverberation in the second stage. First of all, we train the two-stage network separately and separate training parameters as the initial values for the two-stage network joint training. Compared with single-stage network and two-stage frequency domain network, the proposed two-stage time domain network presents better performance.

articleTitle: Compression Algorithm for End-to-End Communication using CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Autoencoder has been applied in end-to-end physical layer communication, and its performance exceeds that of traditional communication systems in some scenarios. However, autoencoder has very high computational complexity and requires a lot of storage resources. This makes them difficult to deploy on embedded systems with limited hardware resources. In this paper, we introduce model compression algorithm for the end-to-end communication system composed of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Firstly, the pruning algorithm for end-to-end communication system is designed to delete the weight coefficients that are not important to the performance. Secondly, according to the characteristics of autoencoder, we design a codebook-based quantization scheme to further reduce the memory consumption. In the case of Gaussian, Rayleigh and bursty fading channels, the experimental results show that the number of weight coefficients and the required resources are greatly reduced after compression, without performance degradation in low Eb/N0 and negligible performance degradation in high Eb/N0.

articleTitle: ARPIC: Personal Information Recognition of ID Card with Interference of Watermark
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Although Optical character recognition (OCR) in printed document texts is well developed, it’s still challenging to recognize the personal information in copy of ID card (CIC) under the interference of visible watermark. To address this issue, we present a framework named ARPIC for automatically recognizing the personal information in CIC. The proposed framework consists of four parts: ID card region detection module (IRDM) to locate and rectify the ID card region, watermark removing module (WRM) to remove the visible watermark overlaying on the ID card region, key texts locating and recognition module (KLRM) to recognize the key texts and text correction module (TCM) to correct the recognition results. Combining data-driven sub-models WRM and KLRM with rule-based sub-models IRDM and TCM, the ARPIC is robust, effective and flexible. Besides, A synthetic dataset has been used for training WRM and KLRM, and for evaluating the performance of ARPIC.

articleTitle: A Multi-Version Spatio-Temporal Indexing Method Based on Clipped Minimum Bounding Boxes
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Efficient organization of spatio-temporal data in real time is a challenging task in scientific studies. Minimum bounding box(MBB) is a widely used technique to approximate adjacent spatial objects in spatial index. And many spatio-temporal indexes extend MBB to index spatio-temporal data. However, there is extensive redundant space in MBB which affects the query efficiency. In this paper, we introduce an optimization method of clipping the bounding boxes for spatio-temporal index. This method significantly improves the filtering efficiency of range query by storing auxiliary points to mark the dead space of the bounding boxes. Experiments in datasets show that our method outperforms with the classical algorithms.

articleTitle: A C&W-based Attack Algorithm for End-to-End Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: End-to-end communication systems based on deep neural networks are extremely vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Specifically, we elaborate on how an attacker can craft Carlini and Wagner attacks (C&W) against end-to-end communication systems. We analyze the effect of this algorithm on end-to-end systems from the perspectives of white-box attacks and black-box attacks. We show that the C&W algorithm is destructive to end-to-end communication systems. We also reveal that white-box attacks are more destructive than black-box attacks. Under blackbox attacks, the block error rate of the system can increase by three orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Channel Characteristics for 5G in Urban Rail Station at 3.5 GHz Based on Ray-Tracing
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, the channel characteristics for 5G wireless system in urban rail station scenario at 3.5 GHz have been investigated. The 3D station scenario model is built. And based on the ray-tracing (RT) technology, Some key channel parameters such as path loss, root mean-square (RMS) delay spread, RMS angular spread, etc., are explored. The maximum allowable path loss (MAPL) is derived by link budget. And at least two micro-cell base stations are needed to meet the coverage of the entire station region.

articleTitle: CFFusion: Cross Framework for Multi-focus Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As a powerful assistance technique for computer vision, multi-focus images fusion has attracted extensive attention in recent years. However, how to accurately detect the focused region from the focused source image is a key problem. To address the weak performance of current fusion methods, in this paper, we proposed a new multi-focus images fusion method. Firstly, the encoder based on VGG-16 aims to extract multi-scale features of the source images. Then, the cross features attention fusion module (CFAFM) integrates multi-scale features for subsequent decoding. Further, the refinement module (RM) aims to refine the predicted coarse decision map. Finally, an all-in focus image is obtained by using the decision map and source images according to the designed fusion rules. Extensive experiments on ‘Lytro’ dataset demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms 5 typical image fusion models and achieves the new state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: A Design Algorithm of Fractional Delay Filter based on Second-order Cone Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To flexibly control the approximation error of the filter frequency response, a fractional delay filter design algorithm based on second-order cone programming (SCP) is proposed in this paper. On the basis of the weighted least squares (WLS) algorithm, the magnitude and phase frequency response approximation constraints of the filter are firstly added. Then the proposed algorithm models the filter design as a second cone programming based convex optimization problem by linearizing magnitude and phase frequency response approximation constraints, and obtains the global optimal solution of the fractional delay filter coefficient. The simulation examples are presented to show the effectiveness of proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Spectrum Monitoring and Analyzing Algorithm Based on Sparse Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nowadays, cutting down on Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) calculating amount remains challenging in spectrum monitoring and analyzing field. The principle of Fast Fourier Transform determines that it consumes equal amount of calculation no matter whether the signal is sparse or dense. Considering this fact, this paper studies on spectrum analyzing algorithm based on Sparse Fourier Transform (SFT). The main theory of this algorithm is locating large value points of signal through Hash Mapping and frequency domain down-sample. After finding large values, Fourier Transform will be conducted only on these points, reducing mathematic operations. This method uses short point FFTs instead of large point ones, which is capable to be promoted even when lacking in hardware resource.

articleTitle: Research of Speech Biomarkers for Stress Recognition Using Linear and Nonlinear Features
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Psychological stress increases the risk of a number of mental disorders such as depression. Stress detection at early time is of great significance for the prevention of mental disorders. This speech-based research is to explore the effective biomarkers for stress detection. Linear and nonlinear features including pitch, short-term energy, sub-band energy ratio, teager energy operator (TEO), formant, mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) were extracted to analyze speech under stress. The results showed that pitch, jitter and short-term energy variance can be effective biomarkers for stress recognition.

articleTitle: Improved Pilot-Symbol-Aided Phase Estimation Algorithm in Homodyne Coherent Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper studies the carrier phase recovery based on pilot symbols in a single carrier system. The system model considered in the paper includes channel additive white noise, phase noise, and device bandwidth limitations. In optical transmission systems based on high-order modulation, the effect of phase noise that affects the phase of the received carrier on system performance may be relevant. We propose an improved pilot symbol aided optical carrier phase recovery (CPR) method, which uses a fixed symbol set for noise suppression in M-QAM. Through the simulation of the 64-QAM system, the performance of this method is studied and compared with the CPR method without a fixed symbol set. The results show that CPR with a fixed symbol set is much better than CPR without a fixed symbol set. In addition, the use of maximum likelihood (ML) phase estimation after pilot symbol assisted CPR can be used to further improve the laser phase noise tolerance. For a dual-polarization system, by inserting pilot symbols in different time slots with different polarization states, the system performance can be further improved.

articleTitle: FMR Low-light Tomato Image Enhancement Algorithm Based on Optimized Homomorphic Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The problem of low illumination is usually caused by insufficient illumination and backlight. The traditional Frankle_Mccann_Retinex algorithm is easy to cause insufficient edge sharpening and color distortion when processing low illumination images, resulting in dark post-processing images and no effective improvement of details in high brightness areas. To solve this problem, an FMR low-light tomato image enhancement algorithm based on optimized homomorphic filtering is proposed in this paper. Combined with color constancy principle, FMR algorithm of optimized homomorphic filtering is used to process low illumination image, and image compression theory and adaptive median filtering are combined to improve the image. Simulation results show that compared with the classical algorithm, the improved FMR algorithm can effectively improve the brightness of low illumination image and enhance the brightness details of the image, and achieve satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Application of DNN with MDFE in Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the continuous development of machine learning, more and more fields have begun to introduce deep learning networks. Intrusion detection is a necessary technology in the industrial field. Many years ago, researchers used dimensionality reduction and then clustering algorithms for intrusion detection. Intrusion detection data often has a large number of features. Although the dimensionality reduction algorithm can retain the effectiveness of the features as much as possible, it still loses the effectiveness of the features from a certain perspective. And the algorithm of dimensionality reduction and then clustering requires multiple steps and multiple calculations to get the final result. The calculation cost is high and the time efficiency is poor. In order to make end-to-end predictions, we try to introduce machine learning into the field of intrusion detection. It is hoped that a large number of features in the field of intrusion detection can be learned through the deep learning network. Meanwhile, the data in the field of intrusion detection is unbalanced. Normal data occupies the majority, and attack data is a small part. This makes the machine learning network to make predictions, and the machine tends to predict all samples into large categories. Therefore, we introduce algorithms in the field of unbalanced data to comprehensively deal with this problem.

articleTitle: Higher Resolution in Range and Velocity for Automotive Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The state-of-the-art automotive radar with chirp sequence at 77GHz is dedicated to achieving higher resolution. The conventional resolution in range and velocity are restricted by the bandwidth and duration of the transmitted signal, respectively. In this paper, we propose a novel method based on compressed sensing (CS) improving the resolution in range and velocity simultaneously without the increase of bandwidth or duration. The proposed method includes three steps: sparse transformation, random sampling and reconstruction. And the Orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) is adopted to recover the sparse signal. Simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. And the performance under different conditions is tested also.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of UHF RFID Metal-mountable tags in Military Food
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, the concepts and principles of radio frequency identification (RFID) technology, ultra-high radio frequency identification (UHF RFID) and ultra-high frequency (UHF) tags were explained. The military food sensory identification simulation experimental platform integrated with software and hardware was designed and built, and the identification performance of UHF RFID metal-mountable tags and common RFID tags were compared by two ways of stacking and tunneling.

articleTitle: Delay-Intolerant Covert Communications With Downlink Non-orthogonal Multiple Access
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the delay-intolerant covert communications with non-orthogonal multiple access (NO-MA), where a fixed effective covert throughput (ECT) at the NOMA-weaker user is guaranteed for the consideration of user fairness. Specifically, we derive a lower bound of the total detection error probability at the warden. Furthermore, we optimize the total transmit power and power allocation factor to maximize the ECT at the NOMA-strong user. Our analyses show that delay-intolerant covert communication can be achieved in the NOMA system, where the maximum ECT is achieved when all the channel uses are utilized. Comparing the covert performance between NOMA and OMA, we find that NOMA has no superior covert performance over OMA in delay-intolerant covert communications.

articleTitle: Forest Pest Detection Method Based on DenseNet and Pyramid Pooling
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Traditional machine learning algorithms have been used in forestry to identify pests, but the results can not adapt to complex environment. In order to realize rapid and accurate pest detection on devices with limited performance, an improved lightweight model ds-YOLOv3-tiny was proposed by us. Firstly, the feature extraction network is changed to DenseNet to improve the feature extraction capability of the network and enable the model to extract high semantic features. We change the network activation function from Leaky ReLU to Swish to cover potential information loss on the network. A detection scale of 52*52 was added through tensor splicing with the second feature scale to enhance the detection ability of small objects. The k-means algorithm is used to cluster the anchors of the network, which makes the network converge more quickly. After feature extraction network, pyramid pooling module was added to improve receptive field, and target features could be learned more comprehensively. After testing, the improved model dsYOLOv3-tiny can still ensure real-time performance, and the accuracy of ds-YOLOv3-tiny is 8.3% higher than that of YOLOv3-tiny, not much different from that of YOLOv3.It is only 49.93MB in size, half the size of YOLOv3. The model dsYOLOv3-tiny in this paper combines the advantages of lightweight network and complex network to ensure the accuracy and real-time performance in forest pest detection.

articleTitle: A NFV-based Universal Network Simulator Platform with Visualization Playback
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Various novel network services have greatly contributed to the development of the network, and network applications play an important role in these services. However, there is a lack of a universal method to analyze network applications in the Internet environment, so this paper proposes a NFV-based platform with visualization playback for solving this problem. The platform deploys network applications in a virtualized environment, and visualizes interaction data of network applications according to custom requirements. Besides, it provides a method to implement applications playback. In this paper, a prototype system is established to analyze DDoS attack application, and the test results show that such a platform can flexibly acquire network applications data in a controllable network environment, and visualize the playback of the network application to reveal or explain the key protocols and mechanisms of network applications.

articleTitle: Vehicle recognition by SDCD lamp sectional distance
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For the need of traffic surveillance, it’s important to detect and recognize the vehicle type and sub-type or modal. In this paper, we propose an sixteen sectional direction chain code (SDCD) algorithm and robust recognition algorithm to retrieve vehicle key lamp features for classification.In this method, we change image with vehicle to logical image and encode the object lamp contour into sixteen direction chain code according to corresponding sectors. Because of frontal lamp type is stable in the vehicle, especially the main lamps, they can be treated as the key feature of the vehicle in recognition and tracing. To increase the recognition effect, we propose sectional weighting method to decrease the interference.By our algorithm, the chain code is transformed into a character sequence to illustrate the feature of lamp contour and express the object feature accurately. For vehicles on the road, the algorithm is robust. Even at night because the advancing vehicle must turn on the lamp at night so that the feature can be retrieved. The type and model recognition accuracy is 98.7% in our experiment. It is an effective vehicle type and modal

articleTitle: Improved K-CV Surface Defects Recognition of Steel Balls Algorithm Combined with PCA and SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of identifying defects on the surface of steel balls, an improved grid search and cross validation (K-CV: K-fold Cross Validation) algorithm is proposed to optimize SVM parameters with method combined of the defect recognition of PCA and SVM. The improved algorithm uses the K-CV (K-fold Cross Validation) algorithm to optimize SVM parameters, minimize the impact of individual sample errors on the prediction model, shorten the search time and improve the face recognition rate. The results show that the recognition rate of surface defects of steel balls, including crack, long pit, rust, turning defect and pore, can reach a recognition rate of 92.5%.

articleTitle: Mobile Internet-oriented Data Preprocessing for Static Routes in Scenic Spots
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To improve the tourist experience of tourists, we propose a data preprocessing method for the static route of the scenic spot. Specifically, the basic value of each scenic spot in the scenic spot is set, the basic data that affects the value of each scenic spot is determined, and the basic data obtained is combined Data, determine the weight that affects the value of each scenic spot; enter the value corresponding to each scenic spot, and get the default value of each scenic spot according to the weight corresponding to each scenic spot. By introducing the concept of the weight of external factors that affect the value of the scenic spot in the process of determining the value of the scenic spot, the actual value of each scenic spot under the influence of external factors can be obtained, so as to pave the way for the subsequent tourist route planning and improve the tour. The effective use of routes and tour time will ultimately improve the experience of tourists visiting scenic spots.

articleTitle: The KICK-OFF of 6G Research Worldwide: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The fifth-generation (5G) mobile system is now being deployed across the world and the scale of 5G subscribers is growing quickly in many countries. The attention of academia and industry is increasingly shifting towards the sixth generation (6G) and many pioneering works are being kicked off, indicating an important milestone in the history of 6G. At this juncture, an overview of the current state of the art of 6G research and a vision of future communications are of great interest. This paper thus investigates up-to-date 6G research programs, ambitions, and main viewpoints of representative countries, institutions and companies worldwide. Then, the key technologies are outlined and a vision on ``What 6G may look like?" is provided. This paper aims to serve as an enlightening guideline for interested researchers to quickly get an overview when kicking off their 6G research.

articleTitle: A Differential Privacy-enhanced Federated Learning Method for Short-Term Household Load Forecasting in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Household Short-term load forecasting is critical to the operation and maintenance of smart grids. As more and more fine-grained electricity consumption data from customers are collected by smart meters deployed in various households, the LSTM recurrent neural network-based load forecasting methods show promising results. However, these methods require the centralized collection and storage of consumers’ electricity consumption data to train forecasting models, which threatens the privacy of customers. Therefore, we proposed a differential privacy-enhanced Federated Learning(DPEFL) method, which collaboratively learns LSTM load forecasting model from data distributed across multiple consumer households. DPEFL provides two levels of privacy protection: first, it keeps the raw consumer data local by federated learning, avoiding the privacy threat posed by centralized data collection and storage; second, it adds noise at the model training process to achieve differential privacy, avoiding the privacy threat posed by attacks on the model. We performed simulations on the data from the Pecan street dataset collected from real households in Texas, USA, and the forecasting results show that DPEFL can create models with high forecasting performance while achieving different levels of privacy guarantees.

articleTitle: Secure Authentication Scheme for VANET Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Internet of Vehicles (IoVs) is a communication environment that consists of various interconnected sensing devices, instruments, and other intelligent vehicles and applications connected. However, since intelligent devices on the IoVs communicate through insecure communication methods, Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network (VANET) may be vulnerable to different types of attacks. Therefore, it is essential to deploy a secure access control solution in the VANET environment, one of the critical security services to protect VANET. In this article, we propose a novel access control scheme for blockchain-based VANET communication. We provide detailed information about the network model and threat model required to design our scheme. The security analysis of the network shows its ability to resist various possible attacks. Furthermore, we introduce other intelligent devices to our network and protect their privacy from prying eyes. We also compared other relevant competing programs and found that our performance is better than these competitive programs. Therefore, our solution is suitable for access control in a blockchain-based VANET environment.

articleTitle: An Efficient Data Query Method of Blockchain Based on Index
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In many blockchain applications, apart from storing the original data, it is also necessary store the data operation records in the blockchain for audit or security.
