Both theoretical derivations and numerical calculation prove that all the desired properties of the mechanism hold.

articleTitle: Implementation and Verification of LTE-V2X Algorithm Based on Software Radio Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: C-V2X has become one of the mainstream technologies of vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communications, which can provide low delay and high-reliability communication. However, the domestic standards related to LTE-V2X are still in the early stage, and to promote the development process, this paper presents in detail the implementation and verification of the LTE-V2X algorithm based on software radio platform. The key technologies of LTE-V2X were analyzed and studied, and the testing work was carried out in the laboratory to complete the symbolic synchronization and physical layer receiving process, and the functionality of the platform was verified.

articleTitle: Smart Community Construction System Architecture Based on Five-viewing Demands
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Community intelligence is one of the important development directions of modern urban construction and governance. Combined with the demands of the owners and property management of the smart community, this paper sorts out the service demands of the owners and property management in five aspects: viewing the personnel access, viewing the vehicle parking, viewing the video surveillance, viewing the intercom and viewing the equipment. Based on these demands, the general system architecture of the construction of the smart community with the concept of five-viewing is proposed. Then the case of Zhonghaihuating smart community is analyzed on the concept and effect of five-viewings.

articleTitle: Reducing Search Complexity of Dynamic SC-Flip Decoding for Polar Codes
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Polar codes are the first error-correcting codes that achieve the Shannon limit under successive cancellation (SC) decoding when the code length is infinite. However, the error-correcting performance of SC decoding is mediocre for short and moderate code lengths. Dynamic successive cancellation flip (DSCF) decoding has been proposed that performs extra SC decoding trails with multi-bit flipping to improve the performance of short and moderate polar codes. The DSCF decoding suffers from high computational complexity and decoding latency since all information bits are tested when searching for the flipping candidates, which leads to intensive metric calculations. To reduce the search complexity of the DSCF, a method based on the critical set (CS) is proposed in this paper to narrow the search range and two types of special nodes, rate-0 nodes and repetition nodes, are incorporated for further complexity reduction. Simulation results show that the proposed method can achieve more than 70% reduction in calculations on metrics, and up to 22.79% reduction in calculations on nodes without performance loss compared to the original DSCF decoding.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv4 Target Detection Algorithm Combined with DCA
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To further perfect the accuracy of the You Only Look Once (YOLO) v4 target detection algorithm, in this research an improved YOLOv4 target detection algorithm combined with a novel attention mechanism Dilated Coordinate Attention (DCA) is proposed. DCA is changed on the basis of Coordinate Attention (CA) attention mechanism in three ways. First, two parallel dilated convolutions with different dilation rates are added. Second, the secondary division of features in the horizontal and vertical directions is abandoned. Third, the information after global average pooling is processed directly. Finally, DCA is embedded into the neck of YOLOv4. The performance of the improved YOLOv4 algorithm is verified on the PASCAL VOC2007+2012 (VOC) dataset, and the average absolute error is introduced during training to optimize the loss function. The experimental results show that compared with other attention mechanisms, DCA achieves the best performance. The mean Average Precision(mAP)@0.5 of the improved YOLOv4 algorithm combined with DCA is 4.27% higher than that of the original YOLOv4. In addition, the precision of the YOLOv3 algorithm integrated with DCA has also been significantly improved to further prove the effectiveness of DCA.

articleTitle: Discriminative Multi-feature Representation for Renal Cancer Detection based on Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Renal cancer is one of the most common cancers in the world, and early diagnosis can increase the possibility of successful treatment and survival rate. However, manual detection is time-consuming and relies heavily on the experience of pathologists. Therefore, it is desirable to employ a computer-aided approach to automate the diagnostic process thereby saving time and labor. To date, a substantial amount of research with common deep learning methods have been applied to address this issue. However, deep learning methods require large numbers of images to train the model. Alternatively, traditional machine learning methods such as texture feature extractors can reach a reasonable result with a smaller computing cost. In this paper, we extensively study the efficiency of texture features extracted from histopathology images at detecting kidney cancer by adopting a weighted fusion method of HOG and GLCM, which includes both local structural features and full texture information from the histopathology images. We applied the proposed method on a histopathology image data set containing 93 patients with renal cancer and 150 patients with normal kidneys. The experimental results indicate that our method can achieve a similar outcome to deep learning methods, while reducing the computing time.

articleTitle: ECC-based Hybrid Beamforming Algorithm in MmWave Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the field of 5G mmWave massive MIMO (Multiple Input Multiple Output) communication systems, we propose a new method whose goal is to reduce the computational complexity of the antenna-side hybrid beamforming algorithm while meeting the requirements of communication spectrum efficiency and error rate. This research is based on a partially connected hybrid beamforming structure. According to the proposed new ECC (Equivalent Channel Capacity) method, the optimal phase information of the analog network can be obtained directly from the fully digital precoder. According to the hardware structure, a method of multiple sub-optimizations is adopted to obtain the analog precoding sub-modules. The simulation results show that the ECC-based hybrid beamforming algorithm can reduce the computational complexity by 75% while achieving the same performance effect as the iterative algorithm.

articleTitle: MMSE Based Combining Robust to Beam Pointing Error for Uplink Multi-User SIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Considering the situation of which the base station (BS) is placed on the flying platform such as unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), the jittering of the BS may lead to unstable beam pointing. This paper investigates the minimum mean square error (MMSE) based combining applicable to multi-user single-input-multiple-output (SIMO) multiple-paths transmission system in the presence of the beam pointing error. The mean square error of the estimated signal after combining should be as small as possible within a range of angle-of-arrival (AoA) while minimizing the power of noise after combining. The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) and augmented Lagrange method (ALM) methods are used jointly to solve the formulated optimization problem and get the robust MMSE combining (RMMSEC) algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed design is more robust than traditional algorithms to the beam pointing error on the bit error ratio (BER) performance.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Energy Harvesting Full-Duplex Relaying Wireless Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, the outage probability and throughput performance of an energy harvesting full-duplex (FD) relaying wireless communication system in Nakagami-m fading channel are discussed. With the help of a decode-and-forward (DF) relay node (R), the source node (S) communicates with the destination node (D), where S and R have no fixed power supply. We consider S can firstly harvest energy from the radio frequency (RF) signals sent by the power beacon, and then transmits signal to R. The R uses a joint power-time splitting protocol to harvest the energy from the received signal and forwards the residual signal to D in FD mode. The analytical expressions of the outage probability and throughput of the considered system are derived, and then we investigate the influences of energy conversion efficiency, time switching coefficient, power splitting ratio as well as the data rate on the system performances. Finally, Monte-Carlo simulation is provided to verify the correctness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: A Dendritic Neuron Model for Breast Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Breast cancer is the most common malignant tumor among women, and the incidence is on the rise all over the world, endangering women's life and health seriously, the prevention and treatment of this disease becomes important. Aiming at the classification problem of breast cancer, this paper uses the dendritic neuron model to mine and analyze the data, and determines the effective learning algorithm of the model for breast cancer data through comparative experiments. The experimental data were collected from two common breast cancer classification datasets in UCI database, and six classical learning algorithms were compared. The experimental results show that the dendritic neuron model has high accuracy, fast convergence, and remarkable classification performance for breast cancer.

articleTitle: Accelerated MR Fingerprinting Reconstruction Using Dictionary and Local Low-Rank Regularizations
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Magnetic resonance fingerprinting (MRF) is a novel quantitative magnetic resonance imaging technique that simultaneously estimates multiple tissue parameters (e.g. spinlattice relaxation time T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, spin-spin relaxation time T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, proton density). However, the high undersampling of k-space data, which is employed to reduce scanning time, results in severe artifacts in the recovered MRF data, and subsequently leads to inaccurate estimation of tissue parameters. In this paper, we propose a new MRF reconstruction method in which dictionary and local low-rank priors are combined to help recovering MRF data from its highly undersampled and noisy k-space data. In addition, an acceleration scheme, which utilizes a singular value decomposition (SVD) to project the signal evolutions onto the principal temporal components of the predefined dictionary, is applied to reduce the computational burden of the proposed method. The numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods for estimation accuracy of tissue parameters with a slight cost of computation time.

articleTitle: Multi-Directional Weighted Interpolation for Color Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a new color filter array interpolation, which has two contributions to demosaicking: different from conventional interpolation methods based on two directions or four directions, the proposed method exploits to a greater degree correlations among more neighboring pixels along eight directions to improve the interpolation performance. As compared with the latest demosaicking algorithms, experiments show that the proposed algorithm provides superior performance in terms of both objective and subjective image qualities.

articleTitle: A Cryptographic Resource Management Framework and Dynamic Migration Method Based on Virtualization
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to meet the complex and diverse cryptographic resource management requirements in the cloud environment, a cryptographic resource management framework based on virtualization technology is proposed. The framework includes a cryptographic resource management unit, a cryptographic resource processing unit, a cryptographic resource storage unit. It can adapt to diverse cryptographic application systems and achieve interconnection and interoperability. A dynamic migration method of the cryptographic service virtual machine is given. Based on the network shared storage system and the memory iterative copy algorithm, it can realize the scheduling and migration of the cryptographic service virtual machine. The management framework and the migration method can realize the normalized processing and scheduling of cryptographic resources, and adapt to a variety of scenarios and cryptographic application requirements in the cloud environment.

articleTitle: Bridge Architecture for Medical Question Answering with Negative Sample Training
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The pre-trained model can achieve good results on a variety of natural language processing tasks which is a breakthrough in the field of natural language processing. However, the pre-trained model is trained on a task-independent corpus, there will be a certain gap between the pre-trained model and downstream tasks. Here we propose a novel bridge architecture to bridge the gap between the pre-trained model and the medical question-answering task. This method does not require a lot of computing resources to fine-tune the pre-trained model, nor does it require specific prompts for downstream tasks. The effectiveness of our architecture is verified by comparison with the strong baseline model. At the same time, we innovatively propose a question answering model training method based on negative sampling with infoNCE loss. Using this training method could improve the effectiveness of the model while greatly reducing the time consumption of model training.

articleTitle: Formalization of the Secrecy Capacity in Non-degraded Wiretap Channel
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Unlike the traditional key-exchange based cryptography, physical layer security is built on information theory and aims to achieve unconditional security by exploiting the physical characteristics of wireless channels. With the growth of the number of wireless devices, physical layer security has been gradually emphasized by researchers. Various physical layer security protocols have been proposed for different communication scenarios. Since these protocols are based on information-theoretic security and the formalization work for information theory were not complete when these protocols were proposed, the security of these protocols lacked formal proofs. In this paper, we propose a formal definition for the secrecy capacity in non-degraded wiretap channel model and a formal proof for the secrecy capacity in binary symmetric channel with the help of SSReflect/Coq theorem prover.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-period LFM Interference Suppression Method Based on Short-Time Fractional Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) provides a valuable tool for the linear frequency modulation (LFM) signal. However, it is not suitable for suppressing multi-period LFM interference. To achieve better anti-jamming performance, we have to overcome numerous obstacles, chief among which are the need for windowing the signal to a single cycle and alleviating the calculation burden. To mitigate the interference, we propose in the current paper an improved method based on the short-time fractional Fourier transform, which can directly estimate the interference signal period and improve interference filtering performance. We take the B1C frequency signal of the BeiDou GNSS receiver as an example to carry out a numerical simulation to compare the improved short-time fractional Fourier transform (STFRFT) method with the traditional one. The results yield in the experiment showed that much better results are observed, in terms of computation burden and acquisition results, especially for a high interference-to-signal ratio (ISR) environment.

articleTitle: The Upper Bound of Capacity for Multi-Mode Networking with Multi-beam Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Considering a disk of a unit area with n nodes, these nodes obey the homogeneous Poisson Point Process with a distribution density of parameter μ. Our purpose is to investigate the capacity of this wireless ad hoc network which uses directional multi-beam transmission technology. Supposing that the network can bear a maximum outage probability of ε, the network capacity could be defined as the product of the data rate, the maximum transmission density when transmitting successfully, and it may be expressed as ${C_\varepsilon }(\mu ) \triangleq \lambda {\mu _\varepsilon }(1 - \varepsilon )$. First, we construct the multi-beam directional antenna and interference area models and propose a low complexity method to calculate the network capacity. Then, based on the concept of random geometry, we analyzed the network architecture and calculated both the maximum data transmission rate and the node density under this condition. Finally, we analyzed the capacity performance among different node's working modes and evaluated the advantages of different modes.

articleTitle: Sidelobe Suppression Using Modified Multiple Population Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a modified multiple population genetic algorithm (MMPGA) is proposed and used for the sidelobe suppression. Being different with the initial MPGA, we introduce the novel crossover method into the MMPGA. The novel crossover method generates more candidate chromosomes by traversing all the possible points. In addition, the proposed MMPGA executes the novel crossover operation on the sub-populations to improve the performance. Compared with the random individuals selection strategy, we select the individual with the highest fitness for the proposed crossover method, and retain the elites with the higher fitness into the new population. Therefore, the proposed method is able to significantly reduce the sidelobe level via optimizing the amplitudes of excitations. Numerical results of 25 elements and 20 elements uniform linear array validate the effectiveness of the proposed MMPGA.

articleTitle: A Dense Dynamic SLAM System Based on Motion Element Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The accuracy of camera pose estimation and map construction is an important factor on availability of path planning, which might be reduced due to the interference from dynamic objects. This paper proposes a dense dynamic SLAM system based on motion element filtering, which realizes the construction of background environment map and the restoration the motion trajectory of dynamic elements. Firstly, after detecting the moving objects in image frames by YOLOv5x algorithm, the system matches ORB feature points to find out the consistency in all objects. Then, based on the results of object detection and semantic segmentation, the dynamic and static feature points in the images are distinguished. After that, the system uses all the static feature points to estimate the pose of the sensor, and constructing a dense background OctoMap. Simultaneously, after estimating the relative pose of each moving object, a global dynamic visual odometry is built by restoring the motion trajectory and real-time inserting the corresponding 3D models in a point cloud space. The experimental results show that the proposed method has better localization effect than ORB-SLAM2 in the dynamic environment. And the system can densely recover background map matching around environment, and globally locate and track the dynamic elements, which retains the dynamic information in the scene.

articleTitle: Design of UAT Transceiver Based on ZIF Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: to address the need for low-cost and miniaturized test equipment for UAT data chain, a ZIF architecture 3U transceiver SDR platform based on FPGA and AD9361 is proposed. The RTL circuit is designed by Verilog HDL language to complete the IQ signal modulation and demodulation of 2CPFSK and RS coding circuit. RF output signal quality testing using test equipment and MATLAB proves that the method can achieve the data chain modulation and demodulation requirements. This method effectively reduces the cost and size of the UAT datalink transceiver and corresponding test equipment, and is an inspiration for ZIF generalized compact RF modems.

articleTitle: Stochastic Perturbation-based Physical-Layer Secret Key Generation in Quasi-Static Scene
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A secret key generation scheme based on stochastic perturbation is proposed to improve the generated secret key rate for quasi-static channels in Internet of Things (IoT). First, the two legitimate nodes send training sequences to estimate the channel information and the initial key is obtained by quantization. Second, each sub-key in the initial key is classified, which the classification label is the column value in the stochastic perturbation matrix. Finally, each sub-key is combined with the corresponding stochastic perturbation sequence through XOR operation to obtain the perturbed key estimation sequence. The simulation results show that with the same SNR, the key generation rate based on stochastic perturbation is faster, and the correlation between the sub-keys is lower. The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) randomness test shows that keys generated based on stochastic perturbation have better randomness.

articleTitle: A New Method of Sample Consensus for 2D Images Matching Based on Combination and Sorting for Spacecrafs Autonomous Optical Navigation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For deal with the problem of rectification of mismatching pairs in 2D images that are taken in the process of spacecraft’s autonomous optical navigation, a method of sample consensus based on combination and sorting (SACCS) is proposed for affine transformation matrix estimation. In this paper, theory of SACCS is firstly introduced and followed by an example, and then, rectification of mismatching pairs is proposed based on SACCS. Finally, a serious of comparison with RANSAC is conducted to test the performance of SACCS.

articleTitle: A Differentially Private SVD Recommendation Algorithm with User Tags
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of Internet commerce and the rapid increase in both amount and types of products, recommendation algorithms play an important role in selecting items of interest to users. Although the classic collaborative filtering recommendation algorithms are simple in principle and has low time complexity, it fails to make full use of the user tags generated by users, which may contain implicit user preferences, resulting in low prediction accuracy and cold start problems. Besides, the classic collaborative filtering algorithms don’t take privacy disclosure issues into consideration, and may expose user preferences during the recommendation process. In order to solve the above problems, a recommendation algorithm named DP-SRAUT (Differentially Private SVD Recommendation Algorithm with User Tags) is presented in the paper. The DP-SRAUT algorithm firstly pre-processes the user's evaluation tag set of items, then generates the users’ semantic preference matrix for items, and the biased SVD approach is used for prediction and item recommendation with the integration of the users’ semantic preference matrix. To preserving user privacy, Laplace noise is added during the training process to meet ε -difference privacy. Experiment results on the Movielens dataset show that the proposed algorithm achieves better accuracy in condition of keeping user privacy.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Routing Algorithm based on Destruction Resistance Cost and Reliability in Flying Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Existing routing algorithms in Flying Ad-Hoc Net- works (FANETs) lack the optimization consideration of destruction resistance cost caused by routing recovery when some nodes fail suddenly. In this paper, we propose a hybrid routing algorithm based on destruction resistance cost and reliability. Based on the real-time network topology and network state, the algorithm can provide a multi-parameters-based routing path with low destruction resistance cost for communication transmission. It can ensure that the main routing path can be quickly recovered after interruption and reduce the process of discovering new routing paths. We have constructed a variety of simulation scenarios to analyze the proposed algorithm and the existing algorithms. The simulation results show that the pro- posed algorithm has good performance in reducing destruction resistance cost.

articleTitle: NOMA-D2D Technology-aided Low delay resource allocation for MEC networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a joint communication and computing resource allocation scheme in mobile edge computing (MEC) networks aided by non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) device-to-device (D2D) technology, in which users are allowed to offload computing tasks to edge servers or D2D receivers. In this case, our optimization goal is to minimize the system delay under consideration of imperfect channel state information (CSI), which results in a multivariate coupled mixed-fraction non-linear programming problem being formulated. To solve this problem, we firstly decouple it into two sub-phases, namely the communication stage and the computing stage, and derive the closed-form expression of the power allocation coefficients without perfect CSI simultaneously. Then a spectrum resource allocation algorithm based on KM (KM-SRA) and a computing resource allocation algorithm based on maximum gain (MG-CRA) are proposed. Finally, by balancing the transmission delay and the computing delay, we propose an iterative algorithm to optimize the system delay according to KM-SRA and MG-CRA. The simulations illustrate that the proposed scheme can reduce the system delay and degrade communication interruption.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-mode Heterogeneous Communication in Low-Voltage Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the proliferation of massive data at power terminals, the demand for communications in low-voltage distribution networks is also increasing. Therefore, an effective wide-area, high-speed, two-way, real-time, and integrated communication system is needed. This paper studies the application of multi-mode heterogeneous communication in low-voltage distribution network. Several wired communication and wireless communication networks are combined to form a heterogeneous network to realize comprehensive perception of equipment status, efficient processing of data and information, and convenient and flexible business applications. The heterogeneous convergent network environment to realize the full coverage of the low-voltage distribution communication network has practical research value to ensure the high reliability and high security of the distribution network communication.

articleTitle: Slicing Allocation Optimization Based on MEC Service-Aware in 5G Smart Grids Enabled Surveillance System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Smart Grids (SGs) expedite the secure, large-scale and efficient two-way communication between the power supply and management by virtue of sophisticated 5G communication infrastructure. In this paper, we propose an efficient strategy of 5G network slicing, with evolved mobile edge computing (MEC) and edge gateways (EGW), between aggregators (small base station, SBS) and SGs terminal units, for efficient service-aware (SA)-quality of service (QoS) synergy. There are notable concerns regarding certain slicing allocation efficiency issues to capture and fulfill the heterogeneous QoS requirements within 5G architectures. By dynamic slicing on the resource grid to determine the candidate slicing pool, the heterogeneous QoS for different services were satisfied via allocating and adjusting slicing resource in non-convex (NC) energy efficiency (EE) optimization mechanism. After pointing out that optimal problem is NC relaxation, we propose Charnes-Cooper transform and Lagrange Multiplier (CC-LM) based algorithm with a low complexity, for maximizing EE in SBS MEC system. Finally, numerical results indicate of convergence of the proposed mechanism and verify a higher degree of efficiency through resource assignment in such 5G MEC architecture.

articleTitle: Compressed Video Quality Metric Based on Just-Noticeable-Difference and Saliency-aware Blocking Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Block-based prediction-quantization hybrid coding framework is widely used in video compression, which results in visually annoying artifacts, i.e., blocking artifacts, on encoded videos. They significantly degrade the Quality-of-Experience (QoE). To improve the QoE, it is crucial to develop Video Quality Assessment (VQA) methods that can identify and quantify various artifacts, among which the negative effect introduced by blocking artifacts is of guiding significance. To evaluate and monitor video quality effectively, a novel Blocking-based Compressed Video Quality Assessment (BCVQA) is proposed in this paper. The key idea of the BCVQA method is a blocking detection model based on Just-Noticeable-Difference (JND) mechanism, which is aimed to improve detection performance, since it only focuses on the observable blocking artifacts. Furthermore, the saliency model is utilized in quality prediction procedure after blocking detection, considering the visual attention mechanism. With the fusion of the above two visual mechanisms, quality prediction of compressed videos becomes more effective, since the useful information is refined in our framework. Experimental results show that the proposed BCVQA is consistent with perceived quality and can effectively evaluate video quality.

articleTitle: Facial Acupoints Location using Transfer Learning on Deep Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the field of traditional Chinese medicine, whether it’s acupuncture, moxibustion or massage health care, are inseparable from acupoints location. In this paper, we combine traditional Chinese medicine with artificial intelligence, proposing a facial acupoints location method on deep residual network. We also create a facial acupoints dataset containing 1040 face images and 9 acupoints. Based on transfer learning, we first train a facial landmarks location network using a facial landmarks dataset. Then, we transfer the learned low-level features to facial acupoints location network, and use an adaptive segmented Wingloss function to reducing the location error. Our experiments indicate that transfer learning and Wingloss function are effective in improving the accuracy of facial acupoints location. The methods used by other researchers often have errors caused by intermediate variables, and most of their studies have no scientific location accuracy index. We have improved these problems, and the normalized average error of the facial acupoints location is 2.5% in our research.

articleTitle: Joint Line Search and ALS Channel Estimation for Intelligent Reflective Surface Assisted MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Intelligent reflective surface (IRS), which allows phase modification of the incident signal, helps to improve transmission quality. Moreover, since IRS is a passive device, it has a natural advantage in reducing energy consumption and recently it has become a hotspot in wireless communication research. Considering that the IRS itself cannot capture the incident data, it brings difficulties to the estimation of the uplink and downlink channels in wireless communication systems. In this paper, we study the channel estimation problem of the IRS-assisted MIMO communication system. We apply a tensor model to describe the cascaded channel of the IRS-assisted MIMO communication system, and use the alternate least squares (ALS) algorithm to extract the uplink and downlink channels from the tensor by tensor decomposition. Traditionally, the ALS method is simple to be understood and implemented, but it takes many iterations to converge in circle iteration. In this paper, we optimize the traditional ALS algorithm by introducing the Line search, and we show that the joint line search ALS algorithm (LSALS) can effectively reduce the number of iterations in the ALS algorithm.

articleTitle: Current Control for PMSM Based on Data-Driven Control
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As the most important part of servo control, the current loop of permanent-magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) directly determines the overall performance of the servo control system. Aiming at the time-varying characteristics of PMSM parameters, a data-driven current control strategy of PMSM is proposed. In the early stage of PMSM control system, the PI controller is used to identify the transfer function parameters of the controlled system in real time according to the input and output data of the system. When the motor parameters change, the parameters of PI controller are changed in real time to give consideration to the stability and rapidity of the control system. The control strategy proposed in this paper is compared with traditional PI algorithm by MATLAB simulation and experiment. The simulation and experimental results show that the current control strategy based on data-driven can improve the current control performance.
